title: Physics-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement of Amortized Bayesian Inference Across Physics
background_knowledge: 该工作处于科学机器学习、贝叶斯统计与物理建模的交叉领域。现代物理与天文学的大量测量可概括为从观测数据 $d$ 反演参数 $\theta$：先验 $\pi(\theta)$ 与似然 $\mathcal{L}(d\mid\theta)$ 给出后验 $p(\theta\mid d)\propto\mathcal{L}(d\mid\theta)\,\pi(\theta)$。当模型非线性、参数维数高、后验多峰或强退化时，传统 MCMC 与嵌套采样虽可作为金标准，却常需数分钟至数天，难以对大批目标、实时实验或不断扩充的星表反复推断。\n\n摊销贝叶斯推断（amortized Bayesian inference）或基于模拟的推断（simulation-based inference）先用模拟器生成 $(\theta, d)$ 训练对，让神经网络学习从 $d$ 到后验的映射；训练完成后，对新观测可在秒级给出后验。其关键困难是：物理后验往往集中在由守恒律、干涉、补偿流和对称性塑造的狭小而弯曲的区域，普通网络难以精确覆盖；同时真实后验不可知，需要重要性采样、似然重加权和覆盖诊断来校验。为提升效率，研究者常引入物理坐标、对称性、归一化流（normalizing flow）、因子分解和精确似然重加权，使摊销推断在保持速度的同时接近金标准采样。该方向横跨系外行星轨道、致密星物态方程、同步辐射薄膜、电生理与生态动力学等，属于科学机器学习与物理推断方法学。
contribution: 论文提出 PhyRSI（physics-guided recursive self-improvement）：让与模拟器耦合的 AI 智能体为每个物理领域自动编写并递归修订摊销贝叶斯推断算法；由于真实后验未知，评分依据是**精确似然的重要性权重**。算法被驱动去发现与物理匹配的坐标、对称性和因子分解：在测量最精确的历元使用轨道要素；对 Fresnel 归一化反射率的多重解分别建立坐标卡；采用使 Na$^+$ 与 K$^+$ 电流相互补偿的坐标；用**共享的中子星物态方程**分解 32 维联合分析；利用捕食者—猎物动力学的时间重标度对称性。\n\n在 6 个领域中，**基于模拟一次性训练的网络能在数秒内给出 36 个真实观测的后验**，经精确似然重加权后，其与收敛马尔可夫链的一致性约等于两条独立马尔可夫链彼此之间的一致性。**这表明推断流程可以由物理规律自动演化并借物理本身校验，而不必逐问题手工设计**；此类后验有望实时引导同步辐射薄膜生长与膜片钳记录、在 X 射线暂现源仍明亮时跟踪其演化、随新增中子星更新致密物质物态方程，并跨星表比较物理模型。
summary: Across physics, from the orbits of imaged exoplanets and the matter inside neutron stars to thin films at synchrotrons and cortical neurons, conservation laws, interference, and compensating currents compress the posteriors of precise data into tiny, curved regions where Markov chains need minutes to days. We introduce PhyRSI (physics-guided recursive self-improvement), in which an AI agent coupled to the simulator writes and revises an amortized Bayesian inference algorithm for each field, scored by the importance weights of the exact likelihood because the true posterior is unknown. It evolves coordinates, symmetries, and factorizations matched to the physics: orbital elements at the best-measured epoch, Fresnel-normalized reflectivity with a chart for each of its multiple solutions, coordinates along which Na+ and K+ currents compensate, a shared neutron-star equation of state that factorizes a 32-dimensional joint analysis, and the time-rescaling symmetry of predator-prey dynamics. In six fields, networks trained once on simulations return 36 posteriors of real observations in seconds, reweighted by the likelihood and agreeing with converged Markov chains about as closely as two independent chains agree with each other. Such posteriors could steer synchrotron film growth and patch-clamp recordings as they run, follow X-ray transients while they are bright, update the dense-matter equation of state as neutron stars are added, and compare physical models across catalogs. Inference can thus be evolved and checked by the physics itself rather than designed by hand for each problem.

title: Revisiting the Double Cluster in Perseus: Are NGC 869 and NGC 884 a true binary system?
background_knowledge: 疏散星团是银河系中年轻恒星集中形成的产物，也是研究恒星演化、星际消光、银河系结构与星团动力学的重要示踪天体。实际观测中，两个在天空上相邻的星团可能只是投影近邻，也可能共享同一恒星形成区、具有共同起源，甚至在引力上相互束缚而构成双星团。判断其是否束缚，需要同时知道成员星、距离、年龄、质量、速度弥散与相对运动，并结合银河系引力场进行轨道和 N-body 演化分析。Gaia 高精度天体测量使成员甄别和三维运动学测量成为可能；CCD 多波段测光则可独立约束色余、距离和年龄。英仙座双星团 NGC 869 与 NGC 884 长期被视为双星团原型，但其物理本质、是否束缚以及未来演化仍有待检验。
contribution: 论文综合新的 CCD $UBV(RI)_{\mathrm{KC}}$ 测光与 Gaia DR3 的高精度天体测量和测光，系统研究英仙座双星团 NGC 869 与 NGC 884 的性质与演化状态，并给出色余、距离和年龄等天体物理参数。结果表明两者均年轻，年龄为 $12 \pm 1$ Myr，且具有相近的测光距离 $2.29$ kpc。作者进一步结合完整度改正后的质量估计与一组 N-body 模拟，分析该系统的运动学和相空间性质，发现 NGC 884 的内部运动学比 NGC 869 表现出更强、更一致的膨胀信号。动力学模拟显示，这对星团在最初 $100$ Myr 内间距迅速增大并超过 $1$ kpc。由此得出结论：**该系统当前并不受引力束缚，不构成双星团；英仙座双星团 presently 处于非束缚状态，且未来积分预测其成员将在相对运动和银河系引力势作用下继续分离。**
summary: We perform a comprehensive study of the Double Cluster in Perseus, NGC 869 and NGC 884, to investigate their nature and evolutionary state. By combining new CCD $UBV(RI)_{KC}$ photometry with high-precision astrometry and photometry from \textit{Gaia} DR3, we determine robust astrophysical parameters, including colour excess, distance, and age. Our analysis confirms that both clusters are young, with an age of $12\pm1$ Myr, and share similar photometric distances of $2.29$ kpc. By integrating these observational constraints with completeness-corrected mass estimates and a suite of N-body simulations, we examine the kinematic and phase-space properties of the system. We find that the internal kinematics of NGC 884 exhibit a stronger and more coherent expansion signature than NGC 869. Our dynamical simulations demonstrate a rapid increase in the separation of the pair during the first 100 Myr, exceeding $1$ kpc. These results indicate that the system is not currently gravitationally bound and does not constitute a binary cluster. Instead, the Double Cluster is presently unbound, and the forward integrations predict that its components will continue to diverge under the influence of their relative motion and the Galactic potential.

title: Broad-line ambiguity in IC 1495
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积提供能量。经典统一模型将观测差异主要归因于视线方向上的尘埃遮挡：宽线区（BLR）是靠近黑洞、运动速度高的气体，产生宽发射线；窄线区（NLR）较远，产生窄发射线。Seyfert 1 型可见宽 H$\alpha$ 等宽线，Seyfert 2 型则被遮挡而主要显示窄线；遮挡程度变化或本征 BLR 变化可导致“变脸”AGN。光谱分解与模型选择（如 BIC）是判断宽线是否真实存在的常用手段，但结果依赖窄线运动学设定、信噪比、孔径与流量定标。注入 - 恢复模拟用于评估在给定噪声和线宽下能否可靠恢复宽线，是检验探测显著性和历史光谱灵敏度的重要工具。
contribution: 论文针对 IC 1495（2MIG 孤立星系目录中的棒旋 Seyfert 星系）宽 H$\alpha$ 是否存在这一争议，将 2004 年 6dFGS 光谱与 2024 年 SDSS-V/BOSS 光谱进行对比，以检验宽线可见性是否随时间变化。2024 年光谱中，[O III] 轮廓更支持存在约 640 km/s 本征 FWHM 的蓝移翼，而 [S II] 与 [O I] 更支持单成分拟合；在 6 个窄线运动学自由的 H$\alpha$ + [N II] 模型中，BIC 首选模型包含本征 FWHM 约 2000 km/s 的宽 H$\alpha$，但当 H$\alpha$ 与 [N II] 共用两个窄线运动学成分时，加入宽 H$\alpha$ 反而使 BIC 变差。按所采用判据，2004 年光谱未探测到宽 H$\alpha$。对参考宽成分（FWHM 约 1930 km/s；宽窄 H$\alpha$ 流量比 0.82）的注入 - 恢复模拟给出基线恢复率 27%–35%，参数网格上为 11%–55%；当流量比增至 1.5 倍时，基线恢复率升至 42%–55%。孔径与流量定标不确定性限制绝对线流量比较。窄线激发、Chandra 光谱（基准模型本征 $N_H \sim 2.3 \times 10^{23}$ cm$^{-2}$）以及长期光学与中红外光变均支持一个被吸收且变化的 Seyfert 核。**因此，2024 年依赖模型的宽 H$\alpha$ 候选体与 2004 年有限的探测灵敏度，尚不足以证明两个历元间宽线可见性发生了变化。**
summary: Published analyses disagree on whether the 2004 6dFGS spectrum of IC 1495, a barred Seyfert galaxy in the 2MIG isolated-galaxy catalogue, contains broad H-alpha. We compare it with a 2024 SDSS-V/BOSS spectrum to assess changes in broad-line visibility. In 2024, the [O III] profile favours a blueshifted wing with intrinsic FWHM ~640 km/s, while [S II] and [O I] favour single-component fits. Among six H-alpha+[N II] models with free narrow-line kinematics, the BIC-preferred fit includes broad H-alpha with intrinsic FWHM ~2000 km/s. However, adding broad H-alpha worsens the BIC when H-alpha and [N II] share two narrow kinematic components. Broad H-alpha is not detected in the 2004 spectrum under the adopted criterion. Injection-recovery simulations of a reference broad component (FWHM ~1930 km/s; broad-to-narrow H-alpha flux ratio 0.82) yield recovery fractions of 27-35% in baseline simulations and 11-55% across the grid. At 1.5 times this flux ratio, baseline recovery rises to 42-55%. Aperture and flux-calibration uncertainties limit absolute line-flux comparisons. Narrow-line excitation, Chandra spectroscopy (intrinsic N_H ~2.3 x 10^23 cm^-2 in the fiducial model), and long-term optical and mid-infrared variability support an absorbed, variable Seyfert nucleus. The model-dependent 2024 broad-H-alpha candidate and limited 2004 sensitivity do not establish a change in broad-line visibility between the epochs.

title: The role of gas on the collisional runaway path to supermassive black hole seeds
background_knowledge: 高红移（$z \gtrsim 6$）类星体的观测表明，在宇宙年龄仅数亿年时，已存在质量达 $10^9\,M_{\odot}$ 量级的超大质量黑洞（SMBH）。在 $\Lambda$CDM 框架下，即使从宇宙早期就持续以爱丁顿极限吸积，也难以在如此短的时间内完成质量积累，因此“种子黑洞”的起源成为该领域的核心问题。主流种子形成渠道大致分为三类：一是大质量第一代恒星（Pop III）坍缩留下的轻种子，质量约 $10^2\,M_{\odot}$；二是大质量气体云在紫外背景抑制下直接坍缩形成的重种子，质量约 $10^4$–$10^5\,M_{\odot}$；三是致密星团中恒星通过动力学过程发生失控碰撞并并合形成的中间质量种子。第三条渠道的物理图像是：在极稠密的星团中，质量分层与双星散射使恒星向中心聚集，核心坍缩后中心形成极密的星群，通过两体碰撞与物理碰撞逐步“滚雪球”式生长，最终形成一个质量为 $10^3$–$10^5\,M_{\odot}$ 的中心天体。气体在这一图像中可能扮演关键角色：它通过耗散与星–气引力相互作用加深中心势阱、加速核心坍缩，并通过动力学摩擦与气体阻力改变恒星轨道，从而影响碰撞速率与种子质量。数值上，此类问题通常用 N-body 方法描述恒星动力学、用 SPH 方法描述气体，并借助 AMUSE 等多物理耦合框架和 BRIDGE 分步积分方法实现引力耦合；但由于碰撞、耗散与分辨率限制，气体对失控碰撞路径的定量作用仍有待厘清。
contribution: 本文针对气体如何影响致密星团中的失控碰撞过程以及随后种子黑洞的形成这一问题，在一个整体不稳定性图像下开展研究。作者使用 AMUSE 框架进行了一系列耦合的 N-body 与 SPH 模拟，其中恒星与气体组分通过 BRIDGE 方法发生引力相互作用。模拟采用 $12$ 组初始条件模型，恒星为等质量恒星并服从 Plummer 分布，总质量范围为 $10^3$–$5\times 10^5\,M_{\odot}$，位力半径为 $0.005$–$0.1\ \mathrm{pc}$，单颗恒星质量为 $1$、$10$ 与 $50\,M_{\odot}$；每组模型分别取 $0\%$–$20\%$ 的气体丰度进行 $4$ 次模拟，共得到 $48$ 次模拟。气体与恒星采用相同的空间分布，单粒子质量比为 $m_{\mathrm{SPH}}/m = 0.01$（$m$ 为恒星质量）。主要结果如下：在多数模拟中，**气体丰度越高，形成的黑洞质量越大**，这是因为核心更早坍缩，并通过星–气相互作用触发碰撞；**黑洞质量的增幅从低气体丰度下的 $\sim 8\%$ 上升到 $20\%$ 气体丰度时的 $\sim 44\%$**；**核心坍缩时间也相应缩短，在 $20\%$ 气体丰度时缩减最多，约为 $27\%$**。作者指出，初始条件所处的跨声速区域在原理上是动力学摩擦最有效的区域；尽管模拟未能完全分辨该效应，但在缺乏其他耗散机制的情况下，**星–气相互作用是驱动黑洞形成效率提升的主要机制**。
summary: The origin of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) remains unclear, despite observational evidence for their rapid formation in the early Universe, as evidenced by active galactic nuclei (AGN) at high redshift. In this paper, we investigate stellar dynamics in dense, gas-embedded clusters. We explore how gas influences the runaway collision process and the subsequent formation of SMBH seeds in a global instability scenario. We perform a series of coupled N-body and SPH simulations using the AMUSE framework, with the stellar and gaseous components interacting gravitationally via the BRIDGE method. We use 12 initial condition models with equal-mass stars following Plummer distributions, with total masses ranging from $10^3$ to $5 \times 10^5~M_{\odot}$, virial radii from $0.005$ to $0.1$ pc, and stellar masses of $1$, $10$ and $50$ $M_{\odot}$. For each model, we perform four simulations with gas fractions ranging from 0\% to 20\%, resulting in a total of 48 simulations. The gas is sampled with the same spatial distribution as the stars, with a mass ratio per particle of $m_{\rm SPH}/m = 0.01$, where $m$ is the stellar mass. We find that in most of our simulations, higher gas fractions lead to the formation of more massive black hole, as the core collapses earlier, triggering collisions through gas--star interactions. Our results show increases in BH mass of $\sim 8\%$ for low gas fractions, to $\sim 44\%$ at 20\% gas fraction. The core collapse time is also shortened, with the strongest reduction at $20\%$ gas fraction ($\sim 27\%$). The transonic regime of our initial conditions is where dynamical friction is most efficient in principle. Although our simulations do not fully resolve this effect, gas--star interactions are the principal mechanism driving the enhancement in BH formation efficiency, in the absence of other dissipation mechanisms.

title: Kinetic Sunyaev Zel'dovich Velocity Reconstruction Using Vision Transformers
background_knowledge: 宇宙微波背景（CMB）带有宇宙早期以及其后演化过程留下的次级各向异性。动理学 Sunyaev–Zel'dovich（kSZ）效应源于 CMB 光子与具有整体本动速度的自由电子发生逆康普顿散射，其温度改变可写为 $\Delta T_{\mathrm{kSZ}} \propto -\int n_e \, \mathbf{v}\cdot\hat{\mathbf{n}} \, d\chi$，其中 $n_e$ 为电子数密度，$\mathbf{v}$ 为电子气的本动速度，$\hat{\mathbf{n}}$ 为视线方向。由于星系、星系团和电离气体等大尺度结构示踪物与速度场通过引力不稳定性相互关联，将 CMB 图与大尺度结构（LSS）示踪物图做交叉相关，便有望统计性地重建大尺度本动速度场。传统方法多采用二次估计器：它在输入场为纯高斯随机场时达到 Fisher 最优，主要利用两点相关信息。然而，非线性引力演化会引入非高斯性，其中可能包含二次估计器未充分利用的信息。近年来，基于模拟训练的机器学习方法被用于从 CMB 与 LSS 图直接学习速度场，为超越高斯近似、提取非高斯信息提供了新途径。
contribution: 论文构建了一套基于 Vision Transformer（ViT）的 kSZ 速度重建流程，利用 CMB 图与大尺度结构示踪物图之间的相关性推断大尺度本动速度场，并与标准二次估计器进行比较。结果表明，该 ViT 方法**能够提升速度重建的保真度**。作者指出，这一改进**与网络利用了二次估计器未纳入的非高斯信息相一致**；但受限于目前仅有的单一模拟实现，**尚不能排除过拟合的影响**。该流程可推广应用于现有及近期 CMB 与 LSS 数据集的全分辨率天图。
summary: Kinetic Sunyaev Zel'dovich (kSZ) velocity reconstruction uses correlations between maps of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) and a tracer of large scale structure (LSS) to infer the large-scale peculiar velocity field. Standard approaches to kSZ velocity reconstruction use quadratic estimators that are Fisher optimal for purely Gaussian fields. Here, we develop a pipeline for kSZ velocity reconstruction based on Vision Transformers (ViT) and show that this approach can improve the fidelity of velocity reconstruction. This is consistent with the network utilizing non-Gaussian information in the inputs that the quadratic estimators do not, though with the single simulation realization we have access to, we cannot exclude overfitting. Our approach can be applied to full-resolution maps from existing and near-term CMB and LSS datasets.

title: Little Red Dots at Cosmic Noon: Spectroscopy Reveals Declining Abundance but a Non-Evolving Luminosity Function Shape
background_knowledge: 在星系与超大质量黑洞共同演化的图景中，活动星系核（AGN）由黑洞吸积释放巨大能量而产生；其中具有宽发射线的系统，其发光气体速度可达数千 $\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$，通常被解释为来自接近黑洞引力势阱的宽线区。高红移类星体是明亮而稀少的代表。JWST 近期发现大量紧凑、偏红且具有宽 Balmer 线的天体，被称为 Little Red Dots（LRDs）。它们在 $z\gtrsim5$ 的数量密度远高于 UV 选类星体，但在本征颜色和形态上不同于传统光学/UV 选样本，因而对 AGN 人口统计、早期黑洞成长以及尘埃遮蔽的理解提出了挑战。宇宙正午（$z\sim 2$ 至 $4$）是恒星形成和黑洞吸积活动的高峰期，也是检验 LRD 种群是否延续、其光度函数是否与类星体相似的关键时期。光度函数描述单位共动体积、单位光度或星等区间内的天体数量，其归一化反映种群丰度，形状（例如拐点亮度）反映典型亮度分布；光谱证认则可校准测光样本的纯度与污染，是人口统计研究的重要基础。
contribution: 作者在 Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Program（HSC-SSP）的 Deep/UltraDeep 天区约 20 $\mathrm{deg}^2$ 范围内搜索宇宙正午（$2\lesssim z\lesssim4$）的 LRDs，并结合 0.3 至 4.5 $\mu$m 的多波段宽场成像，得到 266 个测光 LRD 候选体。利用 Keck/NIRES、VLT/X-shooter 和 Magellan/FIRE 对 24 个候选体开展光谱后随观测，证认出 4 个具有宽 H$\alpha$ 发射的 LRDs。基于光谱校准的测光样本纯度，作者估计在 $2.10<z<2.55$ 时 LRD 的数密度约为 $6.8\times10^{-7}\ \mathrm{cMpc}^{-3}$，**相较 JWST 光谱巡天给出的 $4\lesssim z\lesssim8$ 近似平坦演化水平下降近 35 倍**。**LRD 光学光度函数的拐点在 $2<z<5$ 内始终位于 $M_{5500}\approx -22\ \mathrm{mag}$，低于类星体**。作者进一步推测，**只有 LRD 的丰度随红移演化，而其光学光度函数形状不演化**；Roman Space Telescope 将能利用更大的低红移 LRD 样本对此作出决定性检验。
summary: Little red dots (LRDs) are an extremely abundant population of red, compact, broad-line objects primarily found in the early universe. At $5<z<8$, they are at least 10 times more abundant than UV-selected quasars. Yet, how this population evolves towards lower redshift is unclear. In this work, we present our search for LRDs at cosmic noon ($2\lesssim z\lesssim 4$) in nearly 20 deg$^2$ of the Deep/UltraDeep fields of the Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Program (HSC-SSP). Combining multiwavelength wide-field imaging surveys from 0.3 to 4.5 $μ$m, we identify 266 photometric LRD candidates. With spectroscopic follow-up from Keck/NIRES, VLT/X-shooter, and Magellan/FIRE on 24 candidates, we identify a sample of four LRDs with broad H$α$ emission. With the purity of the photometric sample calibrated by spectroscopy, we estimate the number density of LRDs to be approximately $6.8\times10^{-7}$ cMpc$^{-3}$ at $2.10<z<2.55$---this is nearly a factor of 35 decrease from their flat number density evolution at $4\lesssim z\lesssim8$ estimated from JWST spectroscopic surveys. The knee of the LRD optical luminosity function also remains consistently at $M_{5500}\approx-22$ mag across $2<z<5$, below that of quasars. We further speculate that only the abundance of LRDs, but not the shape of their optical luminosity function, evolves with redshift, and the Roman Space Telescope will be able to test this decisively with a substantially larger sample of low-redshift LRDs.

title: An ALMA Survey of Molecular Gas in the Host Galaxies of Fast Radio Bursts
background_knowledge:
该方向关注星系中的冷分子气体如何为恒星形成供料，以及分子气体储库、恒星形成率与星系演化之间的关系。冷的分子氢（${\rm H}_2$）难以直接观测，CO 的低转动跃迁是常用示踪；通过 CO-to-H2 转换因子可把 CO 光度换算为分子气体质量，再由分子气体质量除以恒星形成率得到耗尽时标，除以恒星质量得到分子气体分数。不同星系在分子气体质量、气体分数和耗尽时标上大致遵循标度关系，偏离这些关系常被用于判断星系环境、演化阶段或恒星形成效率。
\n快速射电暴（FRB）是毫秒级射电暂现源，其色散量表明它们起源于宇宙学距离，少数已被精确定位到宿主星系。FRB 的辐射机制和 progenitor 仍不确定，可能与磁星等高能致密天体有关，也可能与年轻大质量恒星形成区相关。因此，测量宿主星系的冷气体、恒星形成率和金属丰度等性质，可检验 FRB 是否偏好特定星系环境。ALMA 的毫米波与亚毫米波观测能在宇宙学距离上探测 CO 发射和毫米连续谱，但受灵敏度、空间分辨率和转换因子系统误差限制，非探测通常需借助上限和生存统计分析。
contribution:
论文利用 ALMA 对 9 个已定位 FRB 宿主星系（红移 $z=0.05$–$0.38$）开展 CO(1-0)、CO(2-1) 发射和毫米连续谱观测。**CO 在 6 个宿主中显著探测、1 个暂定探测**；在 Milky Way CO-to-H2 转换因子下得到分子气体质量 $2.2\times10^{8}$–$1.0\times10^{10}\,M_{\odot}$。所有 6 个显著探测均显示空间分辨发射和大幅度速度梯度，其中若干与有序盘旋转一致。FRB 位置不必然与最亮 CO 发射重合，在目前 kpc 尺度分辨率下未识别出与爆发位置对应的独特运动学成分。结合已发表数据，作者构建了迄今最大的具有 CO 测量或上限的 FRB 宿主样本。
\n与按恒星质量和恒星形成率匹配的 xCOLD GASS 星系相比，CO 探测宿主倾向于具有更大的分子气体储库和更长的耗尽时标，也倾向于具有更高的分子气体分数和更长的耗尽时标（相对于分子气体标度关系）。然而，包含非探测的生存分析并未确立分子气体质量或气体分数的显著差异；两个同时有 CO 和 HI 探测的宿主，其分子与原子质量比落在比较星系的宽散布内。**总体结果强调 FRB 宿主冷气体环境的多样性，而非一个统一富分子气体的宿主族群。** 在重复暴 FRB 20201124A 位置，98 GHz 连续谱通量密度高于预测的恒星形成贡献，处于 VLA 谱外推的低端或更低；这可允许一个紧凑持久源贡献以及厘米波与毫米波之间可能存在谱转折，但当前灵敏度和分辨率尚不能将其与周围恒星形成发射可靠区分。
summary: We present ALMA observations of CO(1-0) and CO(2-1) emission and millimeter continuum measurements for 9 localized fast radio burst (FRB) hosts at z=0.05-0.38. CO emission is significantly detected in 6 hosts and tentatively detected in one, yielding molecular gas masses of 2.2x10^8-1.0x10^10 Mo for a Milky Way CO-to-H2 conversion factor. All 6 detections show spatially resolved emission and large-scale velocity gradients, several consistent with ordered disk rotation. FRB positions do not necessarily coincide with the brightest CO emission, and no distinct kinematic component is identified at the burst positions at the present kpc-scale resolution. Together with published data, we assemble the largest FRB-host sample with CO measurements or upper limits to date. CO-detected hosts tend to have larger molecular gas reservoirs and longer depletion times than stellar-mass- and star-formation-rate-matched xCOLD GASS galaxies. They also tend to have higher molecular gas fractions and longer depletion times than expected from molecular-gas scaling relations. However, survival analyses including non-detections do not establish a significant difference in molecular gas mass or gas fraction. Both hosts detected in CO and HI have molecular-to-atomic mass ratios within the broad scatter of comparison galaxies. Our results highlight diverse cold-gas environments rather than a uniformly molecular-gas-rich FRB host population. At the position of the repeating FRB20201124A, the measured 98 GHz continuum flux density is above the predicted star-formation contribution and lies at the lower end of or below an extrapolation of the VLA spectrum. These results allow a compact persistent-source contribution and a possible spectral turnover between centimeter and millimeter wavelengths, although the present sensitivity and resolution prevent a firm separation from surrounding star-forming emission.

title: Analytical Modeling of Thermal Shield-Induced Tilt Noise in Lunar Regolith: Constraints on Future Lunar Seismometers and Gravitational waves Detectors
background_knowledge: 月球表面覆盖着热导率很低的月壤，在无大气条件下，太阳辐射的周日加热会在表层产生显著温度波动与热波。若月壤在横向上均匀，常用一维热传导模型描述温度随深度和时间的演化；但热盾、隔热毯、裸露岩石等表面特征会改变太阳辐射吸收与反照率，造成被一维模型忽略的横向温度梯度。温度梯度通过热弹性耦合产生形变，使部署在表面的水平地震仪发生倾斜；在长周期频段，倾斜与水平加速度难以区分，因此会成为地震与惯性传感的重要噪声源。未来月球地震台网以及月球引力波探测中的惯性传感器，均需要在 mHz 频段严格控制此类倾斜噪声。该方向通常以线性热弹性理论、半无限月壤模型、表面辐射平衡边界条件和谱分析为研究范式；对于具有轴对称或横向均匀背景的扰动，Hankel 变换可高效求解温度场与位移场，并利用线性叠加处理多个表面特征。
contribution: 本文建立一个基于半无限月壤中 Hankel 变换的解析框架，把热盾等表面特征视为对横向均匀周日热态的扰动，并利用线性叠加处理多个特征。作者将该框架应用于 Apollo 14 Passive Seismic Experiment（PSE），纳入地震仪热盾及周围仪器的影响。Apollo 热盾为多层隔热毯（MLI），会让一部分太阳通量波动透射至地面；近地方正午时，仪器本体阴影在弱光照射的地面上移动 $2$–$5\ \mathrm{cm}$。该不对称性主导倾斜噪声，其中位振幅谱密度在 $1$–$5\ \mathrm{mHz}$ 达到 $7$–$8 \times 10^{-11}\ \mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$，**比不透明热盾情形高约三个量级**。增大不透明热盾可降低倾斜，但 **MLI 热盾情形下由仪器本体阴影产生的倾斜并不随热盾半径增大而下降**。因此，热不均匀性可产生即使在地震平静期也存在的倾斜偏置，**应纳入未来月球水平地震仪和惯性引力波加速度计的噪声预算**；热盾的光学透射率与仪器自身阴影 **可能比热盾尺寸更重要**。该解析框架计算高效，可用于评估未来月球地震与惯性引力波传感部署中的热盾几何、反照率对比和仪器布局。
summary: Surface features such as thermal shields, insulating blankets, and exposed rocks modify the absorption of solar radiation in the lunar regolith, producing lateral temperature gradients missed by one-dimensional thermal models. These gradients cause thermoelastic deformation that tilts surface-deployed seismic instruments, adding long-period noise. We develop an analytical framework, based on Hankel transforms in a semi-infinite regolith, that treats these features as perturbations to a laterally uniform diurnal thermal state; linearity allows multiple features to be superposed. The framework is applied to the Apollo 14 Passive Seismic Experiment, including the seismometer thermal shield and surrounding instruments. The Apollo shield is a multilayer insulation (MLI) blanket that passes a fraction of the solar-flux fluctuation to the ground. Near local noon the shadow of the instrument body shifts by 2-5 cm across this dimly lit ground. This asymmetry dominates the tilt; its median amplitude spectral density reaches 7-8 x 10^(-11) rad/sqrt(Hz) in the 1-5 mHz band, about three orders of magnitude above that of an opaque shield. Enlarging an opaque shield lowers the tilt, but the body-shadow tilt of an MLI shield does not decrease with shield radius. Thermal heterogeneity can thus generate a tilt bias, present even during seismically quiet intervals, that should be included in the noise budget of future lunar horizontal seismometers and inertial GW accelerometers, and the optical transmission of the shield and the instrument's own shadow can matter more than shield size. The analytical framework provides a computationally efficient way to evaluate thermal-shield geometry, albedo contrast, and instrument placement for future lunar seismic and inertial gravitational-wave sensor deployments.

title: Ohmic warm inflation
background_knowledge:
宇宙暴胀是早期宇宙经历加速膨胀的阶段，可解释宇宙微波背景（CMB）各向异性、宇宙平坦性和视界问题，并由暴胀子场的缓慢滚动及其量子涨落产生原初密度扰动。标准冷暴胀假设暴胀期间物质与辐射可忽略，暴胀结束后通过再加热把暴胀子能量转化为辐射。
\n温暴胀（warm inflation）则假设暴胀子与辐射浴持续耦合，摩擦项将暴胀子能量耗散为辐射，使暴胀期间维持热浴，并改变扰动与慢滚动力学。此类模型需同时满足热浴稳定、耗散系数自洽、暴胀势足够平坦、慢滚条件可行以及无规范或引力反常等要求。额外维、规范场、Wilson line 与格点化/解构（deconstruction）是构造受保护暴胀势和可控摩擦的常见高能物理工具。
contribution:
论文指出，Warm Little Inflation 存在规范反常、缺乏合适的暴胀子势，并且无法维持热浴；其准静态近似高估了耗散功率。作者据此提出一种新的摩擦机制，以及基于一个额外维度中、在 U(1) 规范群下带荷的单个费米子的无反常模型。
\n该模型的四维格点版本是由 $N$ 个 U(1) 规范群组成的环，每个格点放置一个费米子；当 $N=2$ 时退化为无反常的 warm little inflaton 模型。暴胀子为 Wilson line，在 $N \ge 5$ 时受到保护；大 $N$ 可给出合适的 monodromy 暴胀势。在连续极限 $N \to \infty$ 下，暴胀子速度对应五维电场，摩擦转化为欧姆耗散，**该机制似乎能够在与观测相容的前提下维持温暴胀**。
summary: We show that Warm Little Inflation is anomalous, lacks a suitable inflaton potential, and cannot sustain the thermal bath, as the quasi-static approximation over-estimated the dissipated power. To address these issues, we propose a new friction mechanism and new anomaly-free models based on one fermion charged under a U(1) gauge group in one extra dimension. The four-dimensional lattice version is a ring of $N$ U(1) groups with one fermion at each site, reducing to an anomaly-free version of the warm little inflaton model for $N=2$. The inflaton is a Wilson line, protected for $N\ge5$. Large $N$ allows a suitable monodromy inflaton potential. In the continuum limit, $N\to\infty$, the inflaton velocity becomes a five-dimensional electric field and friction becomes Ohmic dissipation, which seems able to sustain warm inflation compatibly with observations.

title: Precise Interstellar Extinction Estimates for Nearly Ten Million Stars Based on Multiple Spectroscopic Surveys
background_knowledge: 星际消光是银河系内尘埃对星光的吸收与散射，短波段更强，因而使恒星变暗并变红。观测上常用色余 $E(B-V)$、总消光 $A_V$ 及消光律参数 $R_V=A_V/E(B-V)$ 描述；消光律的形状与尘埃颗粒尺寸分布、成分和环境有关，在不同视线方向上存在差异。精确消光测量是反推恒星本征颜色、有效温度、表面重力、金属丰度等物理性质，以及确定天体和银河系结构的前提；它也直接影响测光定标、恒星距离尺度和暗弱天体探测。传统消光测量依赖星团、测光颜色-颜色图或分光标准星，受样本量和天区覆盖限制。星对法利用视线方向上的成对恒星：若两颗星具有相近的恒星参数，因而本征颜色相近，但处于不同距离、受到不同程度尘埃遮蔽，则其观测颜色差异主要来自选择性消光；结合光谱给出的恒星参数和距离，可逐对反演视线消光。大规模光谱巡天，如 LAMOST、APOGEE、GALAH、Gaia-ESO、SEGUE、DESI，提供了百万级恒星的光谱参数，但不同巡天的分辨率、波段和参数定标存在系统差异，因此需要交叉校准到统一参数尺度，才能用于大样本、三维消光制图。当前研究范式通常将光谱参数、测光颜色和距离信息结合，构建覆盖天空的三维消光图，并用于银河系结构、星族和测光校准研究。
contribution: 论文联合 LAMOST、APOGEE、GALAH、Gaia-ESO、SEGUE 和 DESI 等多个光学与近红外光谱巡天，采用多层感知机（MLP）和多项式回归，分别对巨星和矮星进行校准，将其统一到 APOGEE 参数尺度，**构建了包含近千万颗恒星、具有校准后大气参数的联合光谱星表**。该星表既为消光测量提供了大样本基础数据，也可作为利用测光巡天估计恒星参数的参考样本。交叉巡天比较以及与高分辨率光谱基准的外部比较表明，校准后的参数具有良好一致性。基于该大样本应用星对法，论文获得了精确的消光估计；结合距离信息，**刻画了覆盖超过 33,000 平方度天区的消光空间分布**。与已有文献对比显示，**消光估计精度达到 $0.019$ 至 $0.022$ mag**。作者还发布了增值星表和开源的 Python 视线消光处理流程，为未来银河系结构研究和测光定标提供支持。
summary: Accurate interstellar extinction estimates are vital for revealing the intrinsic physical properties of stars and the dynamic structure of the Milky Way. Based on multiple optical and near-infrared spectroscopic surveys, including LAMOST, APOGEE, GALAH, GaiaESO, SEGUE, and DESI, we use MLPs and polynomial regressions to calibrate giants and dwarfs separately onto the APOGEE parameter scale, constructing a combined spectroscopic catalog of nearly ten million stars with calibrated stellar atmospheric parameters. This catalog not only provides a robust dataset for our extinction measurements, but also serves as a reference sample for estimating stellar parameters from photometric surveys. Both cross-survey comparisons and external comparisons with high-resolution spectroscopic benchmarks show good agreement in the calibrated parameters. By applying the star-pair method to this extensive sample, we obtain precise extinction estimates. Incorporating distance information, we characterize the spatial distribution of extinction covering over 33,000 square degrees of the sky. Comparisons with existing literature demonstrate that our extinction estimates achieve an exceptional precision of 0.019-0.022 mag. The value-added catalog and open-source Python pipeline for line-of-sight extinction released in this work will provide robust support for future Galactic structure studies and photometric calibrations.

title: WISDOM Project -- XXIX. Catalogue of CO observations of nearby galaxies and the CO Tully-Fisher relation
background_knowledge: Tully–Fisher 关系（TFR）是盘星系中恒星光度（或恒星质量）与旋转速度之间的经验标度关系，常写成 $L \propto V^\alpha$ 或反向形式 $M = a[\log(W/\sin i)-c]+b$。它反映了星系引力势阱、暗物质质量与恒星成分之间的联系，既是研究星系标度律、星系形成与演化的重要工具，也是宇宙距离阶梯中的次级距离指示器。传统上常用 HI 21 cm 线、Hα 或恒星吸收线测量旋转速度，而 CO 分子谱线可高分辨率地示踪冷分子气体运动学，尤其适合 ALMA 对近邻星系开展二维动力学观测。近红外 WISE $W1$ 与 2MASS $K_\text{s}$ 波段光度受尘埃消光影响较小，可较好示踪老年恒星主导的恒星光度或恒星质量。反向 TFR 通常以绝对星等对速度宽度的对数作线性拟合；速度宽度 $W_{50}$ 是积分谱在峰值 $50\%$ 处的宽度，并需按倾角 $i$ 作 $\sin i$ 改正。该关系的斜率、零点及形态依赖性，是检验星系标度律和星系族群差异的重要观测基准。
contribution: 本文利用 ALMA 对 WISDOM（mm-Wave Interferometric Survey of Dark Object Masses）项目 $102$ 个红移 $z \lesssim 0.03$ 的近邻星系开展 CO 观测，其中 $81$ 个获得探测，并以 CO 作为运动学示踪、WISE $W1$ 与 2MASS $K_\text{s}$ 波段星等作为恒星光度示踪，构建 CO Tully–Fisher 关系。最佳拟合的反向 CO TFR 为 $M_{W1}=(-7.18\pm0.93)\left[\log\left(\frac{W_{50}/\sin i}{\text{km~s}^{-1}}\right)-2.6\right]+(-24.04\pm0.13)$ 与 $M_{K_\text{s}}=(-5.95\pm0.62)\left[\log\left(\frac{W_{50}/\sin i}{\text{km~s}^{-1}}\right)-2.6\right]+(-24.01\pm0.10)$。**结果与 Tiley et al. (2016b) 高度一致，二者共同构成了稳健的本地 CO TFR 基准**；但与 Tully & Pierce (2000) 的关系相比，本文测得**更浅的斜率和更小的零点偏移**。考虑到样本的形态多样性，作者分别构建晚型星系与早型星系（ETG）的 CO TFR，发现**在给定速度宽度下，ETG 在 $W1$ 波段暗 $1.40\pm0.39$ mag，在 $K_\text{s}$ 波段暗 $0.89\pm0.28$ mag**。论文还给出并收录了全面的 WISDOM CO 数据产品目录，供后续分子气体研究使用。
summary: We present Tully-Fisher relations (TFRs) that use carbon monoxide (CO) as the kinematic tracer and Wide-Field Infrared Survey Explorer (WISE) $W1$-band and Two Micron All Sky Survey (2MASS) $K_\text{s}$-band magnitudes as tracers of stellar luminosity. CO data were obtained using the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array for the mm-Wave Interferometric Survey of Dark Object Masses (WISDOM) project for a sample of $102$ galaxies located at redshifts $z \lesssim 0.03$, with $81$ detections. The best-fitting reverse $W1$-band and $K_\text{s}$-band CO TFRs are $M_{W1}=(-7.18\pm0.93)\left[\log\left(\frac{W_{50}/\sin i}{\text{km~s}^{-1}}\right)-2.6\right]+(-24.04\pm0.13)$ and $M_{K_\text{s}}=(-5.95\pm0.62)\left[\log\left(\frac{W_{50}/\sin i}{\text{km~s}^{-1}}\right)-2.6\right]+(-24.01\pm0.10)$, respectively, where $W_{50}$ is the velocity width of each integrated CO spectrum at $50\%$ of its maximum, $i$ is the galaxy inclination and $M$ is the galaxy absolute magnitude. Our results are in excellent agreement with those of Tiley et al. (2016b), and together they constitute a robust local benchmark for the CO TFR. We however measure a shallower slope and a smaller zero-point offset compared to the relation of Tully & Pierce (2000). Due to the morphological diversity of our sample, we construct separate late-type and early-type galaxy (ETG) CO TFRs, finding that ETGs are $1.40\pm0.39$~mag fainter at $W1$ band and $0.89\pm0.28$~mag fainter at $K_\text{s}$ band at a given velocity width. We also generate and include a comprehensive catalogue of WISDOM CO data products for use in future molecular gas studies.

title: High-precision proper motions toward the Galactic bulge Baade's window from a decade of DECam observations
background_knowledge: 银河系核球是研究银河系形成与演化、棒旋结构以及早期恒星形成历史的关键区域。传统上，核球观测受到三类限制：恒星高度拥挤导致测光与天体测量困难；星际尘埃消光强烈且空间变化；前景盘星污染严重。Baade's window 是低消光窗口，可较深地观测核球星族。自行是恒星在天球上的横向角速度，沿银经、银纬分量分别记为 $\mu_{\ell^\ast}$ 与 $\mu_b$；对大量恒星测量自行并统计速度弥散，可用于区分核球与盘星、约束核球运动学及星族年龄。高精度天体测量通常需要多历元成像、畸变改正、与 Gaia 等绝对参考架对齐，并在拥挤视场中处理 CCD 系统误差。未来 LSST/Rubin 时代将开展大规模拥挤视场天体测量，因此发展此类管线具有先导意义。
contribution: 论文利用 DECam 在 $r$ 波段的三组观测，时间基线约 10 年，并选取单个探测器覆盖的视场开展试点研究。作者建立了天体测量定标管线，改正 DECam 的 tree-ring 图样与残余畸变，将所有位置统一到 Gaia DR3 参考架，进而测量自行。在试点视场中，共测得 **48,239 颗恒星的自行**，在 $r_0<18$ mag 时中位不确定度为 **0.65 mas yr$^{-1}$**。这些自行与 Gaia DR3 符合良好，且比 Gaia 深约 **1.5 mag**，在相对完备性上与 VIRAC2 相当。作者先用 $\mu_{\ell^\ast}$ 的严格切割并辅以 Gaia DR3 视差选择来分离核球星族，得到核球沿银经和银纬的速度弥散分别为 **$\sigma_{\mu_{\ell^\ast}}=2.76\pm0.03$ mas yr$^{-1}$** 与 **$\sigma_{\mu_b}=2.49\pm0.02$ mas yr$^{-1}$**，与 HST 研究一致。经运动学选择前的前景污染估计约为 **14%**。清洗后的颜色-星等图达到主序拐点以下，且**未显示该视场存在大规模年轻于约 4–5 Gyr 的星族**。由于 LSST 相机与 DECam 采用相同的 CCD 技术，该工作也为 Rubin 时代拥挤视场天体测量提供了重要先导。
summary: A complete characterization of the Galactic bulge stellar populations could offer important clues on the formation and evolution of our Galaxy. However, most bulge fields are hampered by high stellar crowding, strong interstellar extinction, and by heavy contamination from foreground disk stars. We aim to derive proper motions (PMs) towards the Baade's window by using DECam observations, extending kinematic studies of the Galactic bulge below the turn-off to a much larger field of view. We combined three datasets observed with DECam in the $r$-band spanning a ${\sim}$ 10-year baseline. As a pilot study, we only analyzed the field covered by a single detector. We developed an astrometric calibration pipeline that corrects for the DECam tree-ring pattern and residual distortions, tying all positions to the Gaia DR3 reference frame, and used them to derive PMs. We isolated the bulge population through a strict cut in $μ_{\ell^\ast}$, refined with a Gaia DR3 parallax selection. We measured PMs for $48\,239$ stars in the pilot field, with a median uncertainty of $0.65$ mas yr$^{-1}$ at $r_0<18$ mag. Our PMs agree closely with Gaia DR3, and reaches ${\sim}1.5$ magnitudes deeper than Gaia and a comparable depth to VIRAC2 in terms of relative completeness. We found velocity dispersions along Galactic longitude and latitude of $σ_{μ_{\ell^\ast}}=2.76\pm0.03$ mas yr$^{-1}$ and $σ_{μ_b}=2.49\pm0.02$ mas yr$^{-1}$ for the Galactic bulge, consistent with HST studies. We estimated a foreground contamination of ${\sim}14\%$ before any kinematic selection. The cleaned color-magnitude diagram reaches below the main-sequence turnoff, and shows no evidence for a large population younger than ${\sim}4$-$5$ Gyr in this field. Moreover, since the LSST camera shares the same CCD technology as DECam, this work offers a valuable precursor for crowded-field astrometry in the Rubin era.

title: Ultra-diffuse Galaxies in the Kilo-Degree Survey: Globular Cluster Systems in Cluster and Field Environments
background_knowledge: 超扩散星系（ultra-diffuse galaxies, UDGs）是一类有效半径与普通矮星系相近、但表面亮度极低的星系，通常以 $\mu_g \gtrsim 24$--$25\ \mathrm{mag\ arcsec^{-2}}$、恒星质量约 $10^7$--$10^{8.5}\,M_\odot$ 为经验判据。其形成机制仍是星系形成研究中的开放问题，主流图像包括高自旋暗物质晕中的缓慢恒星形成、早期强反馈导致的星系膨胀、主要并合或潮汐相互作用产生的矮星系残骸，以及被星系团环境剥离和猝灭的矮星系等。球状星团（globular clusters, GCs）是年老的致密恒星系统，数量 $N_{\rm GC}$ 和比频度 $S_N$ 可追溯星系早期组装历史；经验上 $N_{\rm GC}$ 与暗物质晕质量相关，因此可用作星系晕质量的间接指示。球状星团光度函数（GCLF）的峰值亮度近似为标准烛光，可用于估计宿主星系距离与物理尺度。环境比较是理解 UDG 形成的重要途径：星系团/群环境中的星系经历潮汐剥离、冲压剥离、引力加热和猝灭，而场星系更可能保留较长期的恒星形成历史。宽视场测光巡天，如 Kilo-Degree Survey（KiDS），结合自动探测方法（如 UDGnet），使大样本、低表面亮度 UDG 及其 GC 系统的统计研究成为可能。
contribution: 论文基于 Kilo-Degree Survey（KiDS）与 UDGnet 识别的 545 个高质量 UDG 候选体，使用专门的球状星团探测管线系统研究其 GC 系统。作者在 24 个 UDG 中探测到 $N_{\rm GC} \geq 3$（14 个位于群或星系团环境，10 个位于场环境），并利用球状星团光度函数估计距离与物理尺度。在固定光度或恒星质量下，群/星系团环境 UDG 往往具有更高的 GC 数和比频度，尽管两类分布显著重叠；大多数 $S_N \gtrsim 40$ 的系统位于群或星系团中，而场 UDG 一般处于分布较低部分。群/星系团 UDG 也更常位于 $N_{\rm GC}$--$M_\star$ 关系的上包络附近。结合经验 GC--晕质量关系，这些结果表明在固定恒星质量下群/星系团 UDG 倾向于具有更高的晕质量和更低的恒星--晕质量比，但该环境趋势较温和。**这些发现与早期高效形成 GC、随后恒星形成被抑制或过早猝灭的图像一致，提示富 GC 的 UDG 可能是矮星系族群的一种延伸；环境差异更可能反映早期组装、猝灭、落入与存活历史的不同，而非场--星系团之间的尖锐二分。**
summary: Ultra-diffuse galaxies (UDGs) are extreme low-surface-brightness systems whose formation pathways remain debated. Globular clusters (GCs) can trace their early assembly, but wide-area studies of UDG GC populations remain scarce. We study GC systems of 545 high-quality UDG candidates identified in the Kilo-Degree Survey (KiDS) with UDGnet, using a dedicated GC-detection pipeline. We identify 24 UDGs with $N_{\rm GC} \geq 3$ (14 associated with groups or clusters and 10 in the field), and use the globular cluster luminosity function to estimate their distances and physical sizes. At fixed luminosity or stellar mass, group- and cluster-associated UDGs tend to have higher GC counts and specific frequencies than field UDGs, although the distributions overlap substantially. Most systems with $S_N \gtrsim 40$ reside in groups or clusters, while field UDGs generally occupy the lower part of the distribution. Group- and cluster-associated UDGs also more often lie near the upper envelope of the $N_{\rm GC}$--$M_\star$ relation. Empirical GC--halo mass relations consequently imply higher halo masses at fixed stellar mass and lower stellar-to-halo mass ratios, although this environmental trend is mild. These findings are consistent with efficient early GC formation followed by suppressed or prematurely quenched field-star formation, suggesting that GC-rich UDGs may represent an extension of the dwarf-galaxy population. The environmental trends may reflect differences in early assembly, quenching, infall, and survival histories rather than a sharp field--cluster dichotomy.

title: Predicting HCN, HCO$^{+}$, multi-transition CO, and dust emission of star-forming galaxies
background_knowledge: 分子谱线与尘埃连续谱是研究恒星形成星系中冷气体、致密云核与星暴活动的核心探针。CO 的转动跃迁因临界密度较低、发射较亮，常被用作 H$_2$ 的质量示踪剂；但把 CO 光度换算为 H$_2$ 质量需要转换因子 $ \alpha_{\rm CO} $，其取值依赖金属丰度、气体密度、速度弥散和辐射场等物理条件。高临界密度分子（如 HCO$^+$、HCN）更偏向示踪致密气体，尘埃连续谱则约束尘埃温度、柱密度与谱指数。对星暴星系中心几十 pc 尺度的解析建模，通常把湍流、团块化、自引力与恒星形成、反馈、入流/外流耦合起来，并用 Toomre 参数 $ Q $ 描述盘的引力稳定性，用质量吸积率 $ \dot{M} $、金属丰度 $ Z $、宇宙线电离率 $ \zeta_{\rm CR} $ 等刻画星际介质状态。该方向的关键问题是：在多分子谱线与连续谱同时可分辨观测时，如何从辐射反推出气体表面密度、速度场和恒星形成率，并判断何种分子跃迁在致密星暴环境中是可靠的质量示踪剂。
contribution: 本文构建了一个湍流、团块化恒星形成盘的解析模型，并在 Circinus 星系中心约 30 pc 区域内同时拟合 6 条分子谱线和 3 个 250–700 GHz 连续谱波段的空间分辨观测。模型以恒星盘性质为输入，在与谱线和连续谱匹配后给出 Toomre 参数 $ Q $、质量吸积率 $ \dot{M} $、金属丰度 $ Z $ 和宇宙线电离率 $ \zeta_{\rm CR} $，进而推断气体表面密度、速度弥散、径向速度与恒星形成率。主要结果包括：**CO-to-H$_2$ 转换因子偏低并随半径变化，$ \alpha_{\rm CO}=0.5 $–$1.5\ M_{\odot}\,{\rm pc}^{-2}/({\rm K\,km\,s}^{-1}) $，接近此类环境的常用值**；**在小尺度上 CO(3–2) 不是气体质量表面密度 $ \Sigma_{{\rm H}_2} $ 的良好示踪剂，较高临界密度的 HCO$^+$(3–2) 等分子能更好地代表 $ \Sigma_{{\rm H}_2} $**；$ \Sigma_{{\rm H}_2} $ 与恒星形成率表面密度 $ \dot{\Sigma}_* $ 呈紧凑星暴系统典型的陡关系，盘平均恒星形成率约 $10\ M_{\odot}\,{\rm kpc}^{-2}\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$，足以驱动星风。尽管如此，与典型大尺度星系盘不同，**注入星际介质的能量主要由气体通过盘的入流主导，而非超新星率主导**；较小半径处入流率的下降可能由星风造成，也可能表明近期从更大尺度来的质量入流增强。作者提出，这类入流率变化可能与 Circinus 中观测到的嵌套旋臂结构有关。
summary: We present an analytical model of a turbulent clumpy star-forming disk that reproduces the spatially resolved observations for 6 molecular lines and 3 continuum bands at 250-700~GHz in the central 30~pc of the Circinus Galaxy. Using the properties of the stellar disk as input, and when matched to the line and continuum emission, the model yields the Toomre $Q$ parameter, mass accretion rate $\dot{M}$, metallicity $Z$, and cosmic ray ionization rate $ζ_{CR}$. These in turn are used to infer the gas properties (surface density, velocity dispersion, and radial velocity) as well as the star formation rate. Our main findings from the model include a low CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor that varies with radius in the range $α_{\rm CO}=0.5$--1.5 $M_{\odot}$pc$^{-2}/({\rm K\,km\,s}^{-1})$, close to the canonical value for such environments. It shows that CO(3-2) is a poor tracer of the gas mass surface density $Σ_{{\rm H}_2}$ on these small scales, which is better represented by molecules such as HCO$^+$(3-2) with higher critical density. The steep relation between $Σ_{{\rm H}_2}$ and star formation rate surface density $\dotΣ_*$ is typical of compact starburst systems, and the star formation rate (10~$M_{\odot}$kpc$^{-2}$yr$^{-1}$ averaged over the disk) is high enough to drive a wind. Despite this, and in contrast to typical large scale galactic disks, the energy injection rate into the ISM is dominated by gas inflow through the disk rather than the supernova rate. As such, the decreasing inflow rate at smaller radii could be caused by a wind, or indicate a recent increase of the mass inflow from larger scales. We suggest that such variations in the inflow rate could be associated with the nested spiral structures which have been observed in Circinus.

title: Little Red Dots at Cosmic Noon: Spectroscopic Identification and Broad-Line Properties
background_knowledge: “小红点”（Little Red Dots, LRDs）是 JWST 时代受到关注的一类致密、未分辨且颜色偏红的河外源，典型 SED 呈“V 形”：静止系紫外相对偏蓝、光学偏红，常在 $z\gtrsim4$ 的高红移样本中被发现。其物理本质仍有争议：可能包括低质量或中等质量超大质量黑洞吸积形成的 AGN、被尘埃严重遮蔽的核区、异常致密的星暴，以及所谓 black hole star 等模型。理解 LRDs 的关键观测包括宽 Balmer 线（尤其是 ${\rm H}\alpha$）、连续谱形状、X 射线辐射和多波段成像。宽线区气体在超大质量黑洞引力场中高速运动，产生宽发射线；宽 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 线可作为 AGN 证认和黑洞质量估计的重要工具。与此同时，Balmer 递减（${\rm H}\alpha/{\rm H}\beta$）对尘埃消光和气体物理条件敏感，Case B 复合给出低密度、无尘埃情形下的基准比值。LRDs 的宽线轮廓常偏离简单高斯，且样本选择强烈依赖测光红移、尘埃红化和空间分辨；因此需要用地面与空间光谱后续、X 射线探测以及 JWST 成像/光谱进行交叉检验。宇宙正午（cosmic noon，约 $z\sim2$--$3$）是恒星形成和黑洞吸积活动的高峰期，也是检验 LRDs 是否为高红移群体低红移对应体的重要窗口。
contribution: 本文利用 Keck/NIRES、VLT/X-shooter 和 Magellan/FIRE 对 $2<z<3$ 的测光选 LRDs 候选体开展靶向 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 的光谱后续观测，以检验 LRDs 在宇宙正午是否仍保留高红移群体的光谱特征。样本母体为 Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Program Deep/UltraDeep 天区 $19.9\ \mathrm{deg}^{2}$ 内 266 个具有 V 形宽波段 SED 的未分辨源；作者观测 24 个源，**确认其中 6 个具有宽 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 线，其余 18 个未显示宽 ${\rm H}\alpha$**。未确认源中，4 个有 ${\rm Ly}\alpha$ 红移，其中 2 个的 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 落在观测覆盖之外；其余 14 个仅有测光红移，${\rm H}\alpha$ 覆盖不确定，原因可能是测光红移错误、宽 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 暗于 $L_{\mathrm{H}\alpha}\approx3\times10^{42}\ \mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$，或它们并非 LRDs。6 条宽 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 线均以指数轮廓拟合最佳，FWHM 约为 $950$--$2150\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$；3 个源显示 Balmer 吸收，所有源 Balmer 递减高于 Case B 预言（${\rm H}\alpha/{\rm H}\beta\approx8$--$34$，但 ${\rm H}\beta$ 未探测），4 个源具有与 JWST 选 LRD 样本一致的 V 形 SED。档案 JWST/NIRCam 成像与 NIRSpec 光谱独立确认其中 1 个源为 LRD；6 个源中有 1 个被 X 射线探测，光度符合普通 AGN，更宜描述为宽线 AGN。作为对照，在 $2<z<3$ 的 7 个尘埃红化 F2M 类星体中仅 1 个、38 个重度红化类星体中仅 2 个满足典型 JWST V 形判据。**6 个宽 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 源中有 4 个（67%）与 JWST 选 LRD 相似，表明地基测光选择与光谱后续能够证认 LRDs。**
summary: We present Keck/NIRES, VLT/X-shooter, and Magellan/FIRE spectroscopic follow-up observations of photometrically selected Little Red Dot (LRD) candidates targeting H$α$ at $2<z<3$. The apparent decline of LRDs at cosmic noon raises the question whether they retain the spectra of the high-redshift population. From a parent sample of 266 unresolved sources with V-shaped broadband SEDs, identified in 19.9\,deg$^2$ of the Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Program Deep/UltraDeep fields, we observe 24 and confirm broad H$α$ in 6. The remaining 18 candidates show no broad H$α$. Four have Ly$α$ redshifts, which place H$α$ outside our coverage for two. The other 14 have only photometric redshifts, so their H$α$ coverage is uncertain; they may have incorrect photometric redshifts, broad H$α$ fainter than $L_{\mathrm{H}α}\approx3\times10^{42}$ erg s$^{-1}$, or not be LRDs. All six broad H$α$ lines are best fit by exponential profiles, with FWHM $\approx 950$--$2150$ km s$^{-1}$. Three show Balmer absorption, all show Balmer decrements above Case B ($Hα/Hβ\approx 8$--$34$, though H$β$ is not detected), and four have V-shaped SEDs consistent with JWST-selected LRD samples. Archival \textit{JWST}/NIRCam imaging and NIRSpec spectroscopy independently confirm one source as an LRD. One of the six is X-ray detected at a luminosity typical of ordinary AGN and is better described as a broad-line AGN. Only one of seven dust-reddened F2M quasars and two of 38 heavily reddened quasars at $2<z<3$ meet typical JWST V-shape criteria. Four of the six sources with broad H$α$ ($67$\%) resemble JWST-selected LRDs, showing that ground-based photometric selection and spectroscopy can identify LRDs.

title: Characterisation of B-type stars in four young Galactic open clusters. II. Photometric variability with TESS and identification of pulsating stars
background_knowledge: 大质量 B 型星约为数倍至十几倍太阳质量，寿命短、辐射强，是研究恒星内部结构、星风、双星演化和星团年龄的重要对象。年轻疏散星团中的成员星近似同年龄、同化学组成且距离相近，因此是检验大质量恒星脉动与双星性质的理想实验室。B 型星的光变可来自脉动、自转调制或双星相互作用；其中 $\beta$ Cephei 星是 B0 至 B2.5 型主序脉动星，通常由铁峰不透明度机制驱动 p/g 模式，周期为小时量级；Be 星则是快速自转、具有盘状包层的 B 型星，其脉动可能与盘和径向速度行为耦合。TESS 的全帧图像提供高占空比测光，但在密集星场中需用点扩散函数（PSF）拟合等方法抑制污染。大质量星的双星比例高，光谱径向速度监测是发现短周期双星的重要手段，而脉动可能引入额外视向速度噪声。
contribution: 论文利用 TESS 全帧图像，对四个年龄约 $15$ 至 $30$ Myr 的银河系疏散星团（h 和 $\chi$ Persei、NGC 457、NGC 581、NGC 1960）中 82 颗 B 型星开展测光变异性分析；采用简单孔径测光与基于点扩散函数（PSF）的方法抑制密集星场污染，成功获得 63 颗星的光变曲线。**在成功提取光变的星中，大多数呈现由脉动引起的光度变化，表明脉动是年轻星团 B 型星的普遍性质**。作者依据光谱型和频率谱对脉动类型分类，发现 **$\beta$ Cephei 星最常见，共 29 颗**，并 **在几乎所有光谱型为 B2 或更早的星中发现脉动模式**；**所有 Be 星均显示脉动**，支持此类星中脉动普遍存在的认识。论文还确认 **多数早型 B 星位于双星系统**，例外为两颗脉动 Be 星和一颗具有自转调制的星；这表明脉动一般不会显著偏置短周期双星的光谱探测，但 **对 Be 星而言，光谱径向速度变异性阈值应高于通常的 $20\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$**。
summary: Pulsations and binarity are important properties of massive stars and influence their structure and evolution. Young open clusters are ideal laboratories to study massive stars, since they are mostly coeval and chemically homogeneous. We analyse 82 B-type stars in the Galactic open clusters $h$ and $χ$ Persei, NGC 457, NGC 581, and NGC 1960, which have ages between 15 and 30 Myr. We extract light curves using both simple aperture photometry and a point-spread-function-based method that minimises contamination from crowded fields in full-frame images from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) mission. We successfully extract light curves for 63 stars. The majority have photometric variability caused by pulsations, showing how pulsations are a common property of young B-type stars in clusters. We classify stars into different pulsator types based on their spectral type and frequency spectrum. The most common pulsator class are beta Cephei stars, with 29 stars in total, and we discover pulsation modes in almost all stars with a spectral type of B2 or earlier. All Be stars show pulsations, which supports the consensus of the ubiquity of pulsations in these stars. Finally, we confirm that the majority of early B-type stars are in binary systems, except for two pulsating Be stars and a star with rotational modulation. This indicates that pulsations do not significantly bias the spectroscopic detection of short-period binaries, except for Be stars where the spectroscopic radial velocity variability threshold should be higher than the typical value of 20 km s$^{-1}$.

title: Coronagraphic time-delay interferometry: fundamental steps towards concrete applications
background_knowledge: 空间引力波天文学旨在利用星载激光干涉仪直接探测毫赫兹频段的引力波。LISA（Laser Interferometer Space Antenna）由三颗卫星组成近似等边三角形的编队，通过卫星间的激光链路测量引力波引起的微小距离变化。由于激光本身的频率噪声远高于引力波信号，数据分析的核心步骤之一是时间延迟干涉（TDI）：将不同时刻、不同链路测得的相位数据按光行时间组合，构造对激光频率噪声不敏感、却保留引力波响应的合成变量。不同 TDI 组合对引力波源的天区位置、偏振等具有不同的几何响应，因此可利用多个组合或特定零流（null stream）通道来反演源的位置。coronagraphic TDI 是一类依赖天区的零流通道：当将其指向某个点源的天区位置时，该通道会抵消这个源的引力波信号。这一性质只依赖 LISA 对源的几何响应，而不依赖具体波形模型，因此被视为实现模型无关天空定位的候选方法。真实 LISA 数据分析还必须处理航天器运动、多个源信号叠加以及仪器噪声等复杂因素；典型源包括银河系双星（GBs）、大质量黑洞双星等。
contribution: 论文围绕 coronagraphic TDI 走向实际 LISA 数据分析所需的三个关键问题展开：航天器运动、信号叠加和仪器噪声。作者推导了第二代 coronagraphic TDI 变量及其解析噪声模型，并证明在存在航天器运动时，该变量仍能压低激光频率噪声，同时恢复源的天区位置。利用成对银河系双星（GBs），研究发现：**只要两个源在频率上不重叠，即使它们位于同一天空位置，也可以被独立定位**；而对于频率重叠的源，**只有当其中一个源的振幅约高出 100 倍时才能实现定位**。对包含一个大质量黑洞双星和 49 个验证 GBs 的模拟数据分析证实了上述结论。作者还提出一种基于解析噪声模型的统计检验，可为源的天区位置给出良好校准的置信区。将该检验应用于含仪器噪声的 GBs 时发现，**仅依靠几何响应对天空位置的约束较弱：即使信噪比达到 $10^4$ 量级，90% 置信区仍可覆盖约 $10^3$ 平方度**。这些工作为 coronagraphic TDI 在 LISA 数据中的天空定位、glitch 鉴别等应用奠定了重要基础。
summary: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) is a future space-based gravitational wave (GW) observatory. Central to LISA data analysis is time-delay interferometry (TDI), which reduces otherwise overwhelming laser frequency noise. In previous work, we explored coronagraphic TDI, a sky-dependent null-stream channel which cancels the GW signal of a point-like source when pointed at its sky position. Because this property relies only on the geometric response of LISA, coronagraphic TDI is a candidate for model-agnostic sky localization. Here, we address three challenges which arise when analyzing realistic LISA data: (i) spacecraft motion; (ii) signal superposition; (iii) instrumental noise. We derive a second-generation coronagraphic TDI variable and its analytic noise model, and show that it reduces laser frequency noise in the presence of spacecraft motion while still recovering the position of the source. Using pairs of Galactic binaries (GBs), we find that sources can be localized independently provided they do not overlap in frequency, even when they share the same sky position, whereas sources overlapping in frequency can only be localized if one dominates by a factor of ~100 in amplitude. This is confirmed by the analysis of a simulation containing a massive black hole binary and 49 verification GBs. Finally, we introduce a statistical test based on the analytic noise model, which provides well-calibrated confidence regions for the sky position of the source. Applying it to GBs in the presence of instrumental noise, we find that the geometric response alone only weakly constrains the sky position: even at signal-to-noise ratios of order 10^4, 90% confidence regions span ~10^3 deg^2. These are fundamental steps towards applications of coronagraphic TDI to LISA data, such as sky localization and glitch discrimination, which we discuss.

title: The Time Domain Telescope: A Global Spectroscopic Array
background_knowledge: 时域天文学研究天体在时间上的亮度、颜色与光谱变化，是连接恒星、致密天体、超新星、黑洞吸积和外流等多类物理过程的研究范式。其基本流程通常是由宽视场成像巡天发现瞬变或爆发事件，再用光谱观测确定红移、化学组成、速度场、能量来源和所处环境；对快速演化或暗弱目标，能否在正确的时间窗口取得足够深的光谱，往往决定科学产出的上限。传统大型光谱望远镜数量有限，难以同时满足高灵敏度、高时间采样和快速响应，因此下一代设施倾向于通过多个单元望远镜组成阵列来增加总集光面积和调度灵活性。自适应光学可缩小点源像斑并压低背景噪声，低读出噪声探测器则有利于短曝光和高节奏观测；这些技术使地面望远镜有可能对远暗于夜天光背景的瞬变进行时间分辨光谱研究。该方向与引力波、中微子等信使的电磁对应体证认密切相关，也服务于宇宙膨胀历史、星系核黑洞增长和恒星演化等广泛课题。
contribution: 该文主要不是报告观测结果，而是提出并定义时域望远镜（TDT）的设施概念与关键性能目标。TDT 计划在 ESO Expanding Horizons 框架下建设一个以欧洲南方天文台为核心、联合全球伙伴的全球光谱阵列，面向光学—近红外的时域分辨与时间关键观测。其核心由 100 台口径 $2$ 米的单元望远镜组成，并在蓝光波段获得全面自适应光学辅助，在 $400$ nm 处 $0.12$ 角秒内包围能量不低于 80%；单元望远镜连接一组光谱仪，覆盖 $0.35$–$1.8$ 微米、$R=10^3$–$10^5$。**极强自适应光学与近零读出噪声探测器的结合，将使 TDT 达到前所未有的深度和/或高节奏观测能力**。**当全部 100 台指向同一目标时，可在 $30$ 分钟内、$R=5000$ 的每个光谱分辨元素达到 $S/N=10$，对 $25$ mag 目标进行光谱观测**。**由此，TDT 的光谱深度有望匹配 Vera Rubin Observatory、Euclid 和 Roman 空间望远镜的成像深度，并覆盖 LISA 与下一代引力波探测器预期发现的电磁对应体亮度**。论文指出其科学范围覆盖外太阳系、恒星与双星系统、河外瞬变、超大质量黑洞增长以及宇宙膨胀历史，并强调该设施具有变革性、独特性，且与当前及近未来 ESO 设施高度互补，特别是能够开展远低于光学夜天光亮度的时域光谱观测。
summary: The Time Domain Telescope (TDT) is an initiative in the context of the ESO Expanding Horizons program. The TDT project aims for a global telescope array for spectroscopic time-resolved and time-critical observations in the optical-near-infrared, with a core at the European Southern Observatory and partners around the world. The TDT core consists of 100 unit telescopes of 2-meter diameter each that are fully Adaptive Optics-assisted in the blue, to deliver an enclosed energy of >=80% within 0.12" at 400nm. The unit telescopes are coupled to a set of spectrographs covering spectral resolutions R=10^3 - 10^5 over the wavelength range 0.35 - 1.8 micrometer. The combination of extreme adaptive optics with near-read-noise-free detectors will allow the TDT to reach unprecedented depths and/or high cadence. When all 100 units target a single object a depth of 25 mag can be reached in 30 minutes at a signal-to-noise ratio of 10 per spectral resolution element at a spectral resolution of R=5000. With this the TDT will spectroscopically match the imaging depth of the Vera Rubin Observatory and the Euclid and Roman spacecrafts, the expected brightness of electromagnetic counterparts discovered by the LISA space mission, as well as by the next-generation gravitational wave detectors. The science of the TDT covers a large part of astronomy, and ranges from the outer Solar System, to stellar and binary systems to extragalactic transients and the growth of supermassive black holes, all the way back to the expansion history of the Universe. The TDT is transformational, unique and highly complementary to the current and near-future ESO facilities, in particular by providing the possibility for time-resolved spectroscopic observations well below the brightness of the optical night sky.

title: Charge Exchange Illuminates Turbulent Cold-Hot Interfaces
background_knowledge: 多相星系周介质（CGM）、星系风和银河系中心常同时包含 $T \sim 10^4$–$10^6\ \mathrm{K}$ 的冷气体与 $T \gtrsim 10^6\ \mathrm{K}$ 的热气体。冷热界面是质量、动量与能量交换以及湍流混合和辐射冷却发生的关键薄层，但界面通常极薄且高度褶皱，直接成像困难。电荷交换（CX）是指高电离金属离子（如 O VIII）从中性原子或离子俘获电子，随后电子级联跃迁并发射软 X 射线谱线；因此 CX 只在高电荷态离子与中性给体共存时出现，可独占地示踪冷热接触区。非平衡电离（NEI）网络追踪离子丰度随冷却、混合和电离背景的演化；辐射湍流混合层模拟研究冷热气团在湍流剪切与冷却作用下的相互渗透。将未分辨的界面物理作为子网格模型嵌入流体模拟，是连接微观电离与发射机制同宏观 CGM 和星系风观测的常用研究范式。
contribution: 论文在辐射湍流混合层的流体模拟中引入子网格 CX 模型，并将其与非平衡电离网络耦合。结果显示，**CX 软 X 射线主要局限在高度褶皱（褶皱因子约 10）的薄冷热界面**，而热发射充满热相；湍流输运可在 $T \sim 10^4$ 至 $10^5\ \mathrm{K}$ 维持高电荷态离子，使其与中性给体相遇。低温 O VIII 的比例高于均匀冷却等压气块，**说明混合显著改变电离历史**。CX 会消耗冷离子群，而持续夹带维持其供应。加入星系际电离背景会改变离子分布，并在本文的 CGM 对比中使 CX 表面亮度提高数倍，**但多数 CX 发射仍来自冷气体**。在中性柱密度足够大时，**CX 表面亮度受离子供应限制**：给体密度升高会提高局部发射率，却缩短反应层。系统尺度的 CX 与热软 X 射线之比还依赖体积与界面面积尺度 $V/A_{\mathrm{int}}$，**使 CX 成为探测 CGM、星系风与银河系中心多相结构的潜在探针**。
summary: Cold-hot interfaces are ubiquitous in the multiphase circumgalactic medium (CGM), galactic winds, and the Galactic Center (GC), yet their microscopic contact regions are difficult to observe. Charge exchange (CX), in which a highly ionized metal ion captures an electron from a neutral donor and emits soft X-ray lines, directly probes these interfaces. We develop a subgrid CX model coupled to a nonequilibrium ionization (NEI) network in hydrodynamic simulations of radiative turbulent mixing layers. CX soft X-rays are confined to a thin, highly corrugated cold-hot interface (corrugation factor $\sim10$), whereas thermal emission fills the hot phase. Turbulent transport sustains high-charge ions at $T\sim 10^4$-$10^5$ K, where they encounter neutral donors. The low-temperature O VIII fraction exceeds that in a uniformly cooling isobaric parcel, demonstrating the importance of mixing to the ionization history. CX depletes this cool ion population, while continued entrainment maintains the supply. Including a metagalactic ionizing background changes the ion distribution and enhances CX surface brightness by a factor of a few in our CGM comparison, but preserves the cool origin of most CX emission. In the limit of sufficient neutral column, CX surface brightness is ion-supply limited: higher donor density increases local emissivity but shortens the reaction layer. The system-wide CX-to-thermal soft X-ray ratio also depends on the volume-to-interface scale $V/A_{\rm int}$, making CX a potential probe of multiphase structure in the CGM, galactic winds, and the GC.

title: An early interaction between the Sagittarius dwarf and the Milky Way I: Fossil signatures in the phase-space structure of the disc
background_knowledge: 在 ΛCDM 框架下，银河系这样的盘星系在暗物质晕中形成，并通过并合与卫星吸积持续增长。较大质量的卫星穿越主星系盘时，会通过引力潮汐扰动加热恒星盘，使盘增厚、垂向速度弥散增大，并在相空间与年龄-运动学关系中留下可追溯的“化石”记录。人马座矮星系是研究这一过程的经典对象：其轨道、多次穿越历史，以及银河系外围低-$\alpha$ 星族的年龄-速度弥散结构，为限制早期相互作用提供了观测线索。理解盘加热需区分恒星年龄：穿越前已形成的恒星会记录扰动，穿越后形成的恒星则继承较冷的新盘状态，因此年龄分辨的垂向结构可用于定年并反演扰动者的性质。
contribution: 作者开展四组受控的 $N$ 体加流体力学模拟：一组为孤立主星系对照，另外三组为银河系型主星系与人马座型卫星在非束缚极轨道上的单次相互作用。相对于总质量 $0.7\times 10^{11}$ M$_\odot$ 的基准卫星，一组将卫星质量提高 1.5 倍，另一组将穿越速度提高 1.4 倍，对应近心点速度 $466$–$634$ km s$^{-1}$、近心点半径 $R\simeq 15$–$18$ kpc。通过按年龄对新形成的薄盘恒星在径向分箱中比较现今相空间结构，作者发现：穿越时已存在的恒星在包含质量定义的高度上最多增厚约 37%，垂向速度弥散最多被加热约 5 km s$^{-1}$，而穿越后形成的恒星不受影响；与由孤立主星系拟合得到的幂指数为 $0.38$ 的加热关系相比，年龄-垂向速度弥散关系也显示出该加热特征。**一次早期相互作用中的单次盘穿越，就足以在年龄分辨的盘垂向结构中留下持久且可定年的化石印记**。基准运行中约 $4$ km s$^{-1}$ 的弥散跃变与银河系外低-$\alpha$ 盘观测（Das et al. 2024）最吻合，对应扰动者质量 $0.7\times 10^{11}$ M$_\odot$、速度 $466$ km s$^{-1}$、近心点半径 $16.7$ kpc；不过由跃变幅度反演扰动者质量的精度仅约为 1.5 倍。
summary: Several independent lines of evidence point to an early encounter between the Milky Way and the Sagittarius dwarf galaxy $5$-$7$ Gyr ago. We present four controlled $N$-body+hydro simulations, one of an isolated host galaxy and three of a single interaction between a Milky-Way-like host and a Sagittarius-like satellite on an unbound polar orbit. Relative to the fiducial satellite (with total mass $0.7\times10^{11}$ M$_\odot$), one run increases the satellite's mass by a factor of $1.5$ and another its crossing speed by a factor of $1.4$, giving pericentric speeds of $466$-$634$ km s$^{-1}$ at pericentric radii of $R\simeq15$-$18$ kpc. Comparing the present-day, phase-space structure in radial bins by age of newly-formed thin-disc stars across the runs, we find that stars that existed at the time of the passage are thickened by up to $\sim37$ per cent in mass-enclosed height and heated by up to $\sim5$ km s$^{-1}$ in vertical velocity dispersion relative to the control, while stars formed after the passage are unaffected. The heating signature is also evident when comparing the age-vertical velocity dispersion relation against a heating relation with a power law of $0.38$, obtained by fitting the isolated host. A single, disc crossing from an early interaction thus suffices to leave lasting, datable fossils in the age-resolved vertical structure of a galactic disc. The fiducial run's dispersion jump of $\sim4$ km s$^{-1}$ matches best with that observed in the outer low-$α$ disc of the Milky Way (Das et al. 2024), corresponding to a perturber mass of $0.7\times10^{11}$ M$_\odot$, with a velocity of $466$ km s$^{-1}$ at a pericentric radius of $16.7$ kpc, though the inversion from jump amplitude to perturber mass is good only to a factor of $\sim1.5$.

title: Effects of Preionisation in Radiative Shocks IV. A Spectral Grid Library of fully Radiative Shock Models with Time--Dependent Precursor
background_knowledge:
辐射激波是星际介质、恒星形成区、行星状星云、超新星遗迹和活动星系核周围等环境中常见的天体物理过程。当超音速气体或喷流扫过周围介质时，激波会压缩并加热气体，使其进入高度电离的等离子体状态；随后气体通过碰撞激发、复合和禁线辐射等过程冷却。激波模型需要同时处理流体动力学、原子物理、辐射转移和电离平衡，才能预测可观测的发射线谱。
\n前驱体（precursor）是指激波本身或其下游高温气体产生的紫外和 X 射线辐射，在激波到达之前对上游气体进行预电离和预热。该效应会改变激波两侧的密度、温度和电离结构，进而影响发射线强度与比值。由于电离和复合具有有限时标，前驱体的影响往往是时间依赖的，尤其在不同激波速度和介质密度下更为复杂。
\n激波模型谱库被广泛用于解释天体光谱，并推断激波速度、介质密度、元素丰度、磁场强度和激波年龄等参数。不同代码、原子数据和前驱体处理方式会导致模型谱存在系统差异，因此更新模型网格并与旧版比较，对正确使用激波诊断具有重要意义。
contribution:
论文基于改进的 MAPPINGS V 激波与光电离代码，构建了一套新的全辐射激波模型谱库，并包含时间依赖的前驱体处理。相较于 Allen et al.（2008）使用 MAPPINGS III 建立的常用网格，MAPPINGS V 显著改进了前驱体发射的处理，采用了更稳健的自适应网格激波求解器（Sutherland & Dopita 2017），并更新了原子数据。

**新谱库覆盖 $50$--$1000\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$ 的激波速度范围，并包含广泛的初始条件和更新后的元素丰度。** 作者将新模型与早期网格进行比较，讨论二者差异，并说明这些激波模型最可能近似哪些类型天体物理对象的条件。论文强调，预期观测到的发射取决于多种因素，包括激波速度、激波所扫过物质的密度与丰度、磁场以及激波的有效年龄。**因此，时间依赖前驱体和更新原子物理处理会对激波发射谱及模型解释产生重要影响。**
summary: Here we present an extensive set of shock models calculated using an improved version of the MAPPINGS shock and photoionization code. The new version of MAPPINGS, namely MAPPINGS V, has a greatly improved treatment of the precursor emission, a more robust adaptive-mesh shock solver (Sutherland & Dopita 2017), and new atomic data compared to MAPPINGS III, which was used by Allen et al. (2008) to create their widely used shock model grid. The new shock model library covers the shock velocity range 50-1000 km/s, and a wide range of initial conditions and updated abundances. We highlight how the newer models compare to the earlier grid, and discuss where the shock models are most likely to approximate conditions for various types of astrophysical objects. The emission that one expects to observe depends on a variety of factors, including the velocity of the shock, the density and abundance of material the shock is encountering, the magnetic field and the effective age of the shock.

title: The MURALES survey. IX. MUSE observations and results for 3C radio sources at 0.3 < z < 0.82
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积驱动，其中射电噪 AGN 常产生相对论性喷流。喷流在星系际/星系周介质中传播时，会形成射电瓣、热斑、茧和气泡等结构，并通过激波、湍流和气体混合与周围多相气体发生能量和动量交换，这被视为 AGN 反馈的重要形式。射电星系周围常存在尺度达几十千秒差距的电离气体，可能呈盘状、丝状或团块状；其形态和运动学可通过 Hα、[O III] 等发射线追踪。积分视场光谱（如 VLT/MUSE）能够同时获得延展发射线区的空间分布与速度场，从而检验电离气体是否随射电喷流被推动、加热或剥离，以及气体大尺度旋转与射电结构取向之间的关系。一个关键图像是所谓超级盘：射电星系周围可能存在尺度远大于恒星盘的旋转电离气体结构，其与喷流的相互作用取决于射电源的演化阶段和喷流相对于气体盘的取向。中等红移 $0.3 < z < 0.82$ 的样本处于连接近邻射电星系与更高红移宇宙的重要窗口，有助于理解 AGN 反馈、星系周介质和射电源生命周期。
contribution: 本文是 MURALES（MUse RAdio Loud Emission lines Snapshot）项目第九篇论文，利用 VLT/MUSE 积分视场光谱观测 26 个红移 $0.3 < z < 0.82$ 的 3C 射电源，研究其延展发射线区（EELR）的形态、运动学及其与射电喷出物的关系。除 4 个源外，其余源均探测到 EELR，最远延伸至 160 kpc；这些 EELR 呈现多种形态和运动学特征，且通常与射电性质相关。五个与较小射电源成协的源表现出高度扰动的气体运动学；若干 EELR 呈丝状形态，并常形成由射电瓣膨胀产生的气泡；更延展的 EELR 通常呈细长形态并显示良好有序的旋转。作者由此确认了在较低红移源中得到的一般性结果：**射电星系周围存在尺度达数十千秒差距的电离气体超级盘，其性质取决于射电源的演化状态及其相对于超级盘的取向**。
summary: This is the ninth paper in the MUse RAdio Loud Emission lines Snapshot (MURALES) project series, presenting the results of observations of 3C radio sources obtained with the VLT/MUSE integral field spectrograph. Here, we investigate the morphology and kinematics of the extended emission line regions (EELRs) of 26 radio galaxies at intermediate redshift 0.3 < z < 0.82 and their relation with the radio ejecta. EELRs are observed in all but 4 of the 26 sources extending as far as 160 kpc from the host galaxy. They show different morphologies and kinematics usually related with the radio properties. The five sources associated with the smaller radio sources show highly disturbed gas kinematics. Several EELRs have a filamentary morphology, often forming bubbles inflated by the radio lobes. The more extended EELRs usually have elongated morphologies and show well-ordered rotation. We then confirm the general results obtained from the study of the source at lower redshift: radio galaxies are surrounded by super-disks, that is, structures of ionized gas on scales of many tens of kiloparsec, whose properties depend on a combination of the evolutionary state of the radio source and its orientation with respect to the super-disks.

title: Lost in the Signal Model: Confusion Between Deterministic and Stochastic Gravitational Wave Signals in Pulsar Timing Array Data
background_knowledge: 脉冲星计时阵列（Pulsar Timing Array，PTA）通过长期监测多颗毫秒脉冲星的脉冲到达时间并构造计时残差，寻找纳赫兹引力波留下的特征相关性。随机引力波背景（Gravitational Wave Background，GWB）通常被建模为大量超大质量黑洞双星（Supermassive Black Hole Binary，SMBHB）等源叠加形成的随机场，其统计特征可用幂律谱 $f^{-\gamma}$ 描述，并通过脉冲星对之间的 Hellings-Downs 空间相关函数加以识别。单个近邻、强引力波辐射的 SMBHB 则可能表现为确定性的连续波信号，在计时残差中具有特定的演化与天空位置依赖。二者在 PTA 数据中均为跨越多年的持续信号，且频段和时域特征可能重叠，因此信号建模、前景扣除与联合参数估计十分关键；若把一种信号错误归入另一种模型，可能导致对 GWB 振幅、谱指数或单个源参数的偏差。这一背景连接了引力波天体物理、SMBHB 演化与多信使观测。
contribution: 论文针对 PTA 数据中随机 GWB 与单个 SMBHB 确定性信号可能相互混淆的问题，分析单个 SMBHB 信号如何影响 GWB 的探测统计，以及 GWB 如何影响对 SMBHB 系统的搜寻。研究发现，单个 SMBHB 信号会显著扭曲 GWB 振幅与谱指数的恢复；但当 SMBHB 信号被一致地恢复时，仍可重新获得 GWB 的幂律参数，**表明未来 PTA 引力波搜寻中联合搜寻 GWB 与单个 SMBHB 信号至关重要**。论文还考察参数估计不确定度随观测或信号条件改善而下降的速率，为判断哪些信号最可能被足够精确地刻画、从而支持多信使分析提供依据。
summary: With growing evidence for the presence of a gravitational wave background (GWB) in pulsar timing array (PTA) data, it is imperative to understand how this signal will act as a foreground for other GW signals, particularly those from individual supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), which are predicted to be detected in the next decade. For PTAs, since these two types of signals are long-timescale persistent signals, a signal from an SMBHB system may already be present in the latest PTA datasets. In this work, we analyze how the presence of this signal could affect our detection statistics for the GWB, and how the presence of the GWB can affect our search for the SMBHB system. We find that individual SMBHB signals can significantly skew the recovery of the GWB amplitude and spectral index. However, when the SMBHB signals are recovered consistently, we are again able to recover the GWB power-law parameters, highlighting the importance of joint searches in future PTA searches for GWs. We also explore the rate of improvement of parameter estimation uncertainty, giving insight to the types of signals most likely to be identified well enough to enable multimessenger analyses.

title: Features investigated: A detailed study of axion monodromy inflation using CLiENT
background_knowledge: 宇宙暴胀是极早期宇宙的加速膨胀阶段，它把量子涨落拉伸为宏观的原初曲率扰动，并形成原初功率谱。标准慢滚暴胀预言功率谱近似幂律、近标度不变；若暴胀子势能或粒子产生过程含有额外结构，则功率谱可能出现周期性或局域振荡特征。轴子单值（axion monodromy）模型通过轴子场的单值势与额外能标耦合，预言此类振荡，其频率、振幅和相位可被 CMB 温度、极化、透镜以及大尺度结构、超新星等数据检验。观测分析通常在全参数空间中计算后验、剖面似然与贝叶斯证据；由于振荡特征使似然面高度多峰且计算昂贵，常用机器学习代理模型（emulator）加速，并需考虑 look-elsewhere effect 以评估搜索多重性带来的显著性衰减。
contribution: 论文利用 CLiENT 代理框架，针对 axion monodromy 暴胀预言的原初功率谱振荡特征，精确计算后验、剖面似然和贝叶斯证据。采用两组数据：保守组合为 Planck PR4 温度、极化与透镜数据，加上 DESI DR2 BAO 和 Pantheon+ 超新星；激进组合还加入 ACT 与 SPT 的小尺度 CMB 数据。**在现有数据中未发现稳健的振荡特征。** 保守数据的最佳拟合频率为 $ \omega \simeq 51 $，相对无特征谱使 $ \chi^2 $ 降低 10.1；但该特征被激进数据排斥，后者最佳拟合在 $ \omega \simeq 31 $，仅使 $ \chi^2 $ 降低 7.4。已知对无特征数据的拟合也能产生类似改善，且 AIC、Bayes factor 与 look-elsewhere effect 均表明这两处改善不显著。振荡振幅被限制为 $ A_{\mathrm{osc}} < 0.056 $ 和 $ A_{\mathrm{osc}} < 0.062 $（95% 置信度）。代理模型在后验样本处重现真实对数似然的均方根误差分别为 0.07 和 0.16；剖面似然则使用 CLiENT 的 profile 功能并基于真实似然计算。
summary: We investigate features in the primordial power spectrum from inflation, specifically those predicted by the axion monodromy model, using recent observational data. In order to compute posteriors, profile likelihoods and Bayesian evidence accurately for the complex likelihood surfaces arising in this model we have used the CLiENT emulator framework. As our data combinations we use both a "conservative" set consisting of Planck PR4 temperature, polarisation and lensing data together with DESI DR2 BAO and Pantheon+ supernovae, and a more "aggressive" set which also includes small-scale CMB data from ACT and SPT. We find no robust oscillatory feature in current data. With the conservative data the best fit lies at a frequency $ω\simeq 51$ and lowers $χ^2$ by 10.1 relative to a featureless spectrum. However, this feature is disfavoured by the more aggressive data combination, whose best fit lies at $ω\simeq 31$ and lowers $χ^2$ by 7.4. Fits to featureless data are known to give similar improvements, and the Akaike information criterion, the Bayes factors and the look-elsewhere effect all indicate that neither improvement is significant. The amplitude is limited to $A_\mathrm{osc} < 0.056$ and $A_\mathrm{osc} < 0.062$ (95%) for the two datasets. The emulators reproduce the true log-likelihood at samples of their posteriors with rms errors of 0.07 and 0.16, and the profile likelihoods are calculated with the true likelihood, using the profile capability of CLiENT.

title: Fast and accurate large-volume Lyman-$α$ forest mocks with three-dimensional U-Net trained on IllustrisTNG and FLAMINGO
background_knowledge: 莱曼-$\alpha$ 森林是高红移类星体光谱中由视线方向星系际介质中性氢吸收形成的吸收线序列；其透射通量涨落对暗物质主导的密度场、速度场、气体温度与电离状态敏感，因而在 $2\lesssim z\lesssim 4$ 成为探测大尺度结构、重子声学振荡、中微子质量和暗物质性质的重要探针。研究范式通常是把流体动力学模拟或近似 mock 生成的通量统计（如一维功率谱 $P_{\mathrm{1D}}$、双谱、三谱与通量 PDF）与观测比较，并通过贝叶斯推断约束宇宙学与天体物理参数。关键困难在于：观测样本覆盖 Gpc 级体积，而小尺度物理又需要高分辨率；同时满足两者的流体动力学模拟计算成本极高。近年来，机器学习场级代理模型（field-level emulator）被用于以较低计算成本生成大体积、并保留小尺度统计特征的 mock。
contribution: 论文提出一种基于三维 U-Net 的场级仿真器，将近似密度场和速度场直接映射为 Ly$\alpha$ 光学厚度与透射通量。作者在 $z\sim 3$ 下采用“小体积训练、大体积独立测试”策略：对 IllustrisTNG，在 $110\,\mathrm{cMpc}$ 盒子训练，在 $300\,\mathrm{cMpc}$ 盒子上以 2LPT 和 N-body 输入测试；对 FLAMINGO，在 $1\,\mathrm{cGpc}$ 训练，在 $2.8\,\mathrm{cGpc}$ 上用 N-body 输入测试。结果发现 TNG 与 FLAMINGO 的流体动力学统计在共同 $k$ 范围内差异可观：$P_{\mathrm{1D}}$ 约 $15\%$、双谱约 $17\%$、连通三谱约 $40\%$，但两者归一化功率谱的相关结构大体相似。每个模拟套件内，仿真器将 $P_{\mathrm{1D}}$ 重现到 TNG $2.8\%$、FLAMINGO $5.6\%$，双谱到 $4\%$--$5\%$，三谱到 $10\%$--$16\%$，并恢复透射通量 PDF 和宽相关结构。**因此，场级仿真为大体积 Ly$\alpha$ 森林 mock 的生成提供了面向当前与未来光谱巡天的实用途径。**
summary: The Lyman-$α$ forest probes matter structure at $z\gtrsim2$, constraining baryon acoustic oscillations, neutrino masses, and dark matter properties. Interpreting current and upcoming spectroscopic surveys requires mock catalogues spanning Gpc-scale volumes while capturing small-scale intergalactic medium physics. This combination of high resolution and large volume is prohibitively expensive for hydrodynamical simulations. We present a field-level emulator, based on a three-dimensional U-Net, that maps approximate density and velocity fields directly to Ly$α$ optical depth and transmitted flux. At $z\sim3$, we train in small volumes and test on much larger, independent ones in two settings: IllustrisTNG (training on a $110\,\mathrm{cMpc}$ box and testing on a $300\,\mathrm{cMpc}$ box with 2LPT and $N$-body inputs) and FLAMINGO (training on $1\,\mathrm{cGpc}$ and testing on $2.8\,\mathrm{cGpc}$ with $N$-body inputs). The hydrodynamical statistics of TNG and FLAMINGO differ appreciably over their common $k$-range, by $\sim15\%$ in $P_{\rm 1D}$, $\sim17\%$ in the bispectrum, and $\sim40\%$ in the connected trispectrum, although their normalized power-spectrum correlation structures remain broadly similar. Within each suite, the emulator reproduces $P_{\rm 1D}$ to $2.8\%$ in TNG and $5.6\%$ in FLAMINGO, the bispectrum to $4$--$5\%$, and the trispectrum to $10$--$16\%$, while also recovering the flux PDF and broad correlation structure. Field-level emulation thus provides a practical route to large-volume Ly$α$-forest mocks for current and future surveys.

title: The relation between DCN/DNC ratios and gas temperature in late-stage massive star-forming regions using Yebes observations
background_knowledge: 星际介质中的分子云是恒星形成的场所，其物理状态由密度、温度、湍流、辐射场和化学演化共同决定。大质量恒星形成晚期，周围致密气体已被加热并受到新生恒星的辐射与反馈影响，分子丰度和谱线比值会随演化阶段改变。氘代分子是研究这些过程的敏感探针：在冷、致密且 CO 耗竭的环境中，氘分数可以显著增强；温度升高会改变放热交换反应与后续化学路径，因此含氘分子丰度及其比值携带气体温度和化学年龄的信息。DCN 与 DNC 是 HCN 与 HNC 的氘代对应物/异构体，其比值 $[\mathrm{DCN}]/[\mathrm{DNC}]$ 可能同时受 HCN/HNC 异构化化学和氘代分馏控制；虽然 $[\mathrm{HCN}]/[\mathrm{HNC}]$ 常被预期在较暖气体中升高，但 $[\mathrm{DCN}]/[\mathrm{DNC}]$ 的温度依赖此前约束较弱。观测上，该领域常利用单天线望远镜对大批分子云或恒星形成区开展分子谱线巡测，测量转动跃迁强度，结合局部热动平衡或辐射转移假设估计柱密度和丰度比，并用 $\mathrm{CH_3CCH}$ 等分子作为致密气体动理学温度计，进而与化学模型和演化图像比较。
contribution: 论文利用 Yebes 40 m 望远镜，对 101 个晚期大质量恒星形成区观测了 DCN、DNC、$\mathrm{H^{13}CN}$、$\mathrm{HN^{13}C}$、$\mathrm{HC^{15}N}$ 与 $\mathrm{H^{15}NC}$ 的 $J=1-0$ 跃迁，并采用 $\mathrm{CH_3CCH}$ $5-4$ 的转动温度估计致密气体的动理学温度；这些温度被用于柱密度计算和温度依赖丰度比分析。核心结果是：$[\mathrm{DCN}]/[\mathrm{DNC}]$ 与气体动理学温度呈**中等强度的正相关，且统计显著**，表明在更暖气体中 DCN 相对于 DNC 逐渐更丰富；$D_{\rm frac}(\mathrm{HNC})$ 与温度呈**弱负相关**，而 $D_{\rm frac}(\mathrm{HCN})$ 与温度**无统计显著相关**。$[\mathrm{HCN}]/[\mathrm{HNC}]$ 的散差较大，与温度**没有统计显著相关**，这可能部分源于 $^{13}\mathrm{C}$ 同位素分子的光学厚度效应以及 $^{15}\mathrm{N}$ 同位素观测灵敏度有限。作者据此提出，$[\mathrm{DCN}]/[\mathrm{DNC}]$ 可能不仅由 HCN/HNC 异构体化学决定，还受**温度依赖的氘代分馏路径**和致密气体**化学演化**影响。
summary: Deuterated molecules probe the physical and chemical evolution of molecular clouds and star-forming regions. Their abundances depend on temperature, density, and evolutionary stage. DCN and DNC are relatively abundant deuterated isomers that probe temperature-dependent deuterium chemistry. Although [HCN]/[HNC] is often thought to increase in warmer gas, the temperature dependence of [DCN]/[DNC] remains less well constrained. To investigate how [DCN]/[DNC] depends on the gas kinetic temperature, we observed the $J$=1-0 transitions of DCN, DNC, H$^{13}$CN, HN$^{13}$C, HC$^{15}$N, and H$^{15}$NC toward 101 late-stage massive star-forming regions using the Yebes 40m telescope. Gas kinetic temperatures were estimated from CH$_3$CCH 5-4, whose rotation temperature is closely related to the kinetic temperature of dense gas. These temperatures were adopted in the column density calculations and in the analysis of temperature-dependent abundance ratios. We find a moderate positive correlation between the abundance ratio [DCN]/[DNC] and kinetic temperature, which is statistically significant and indicates that DCN becomes progressively more abundant relative to DNC in warmer gas. A weak negative correlation with temperature is observed for $D_{\rm frac}({\rm HNC})$, whereas no statistically significant correlation is found for $D_{\rm frac}({\rm HCN})$. The [HCN]/[HNC] ratios show substantial scatter and no statistically significant correlation with temperature, possibly due in part to optical-depth effects in the $^{13}$C isotopologues and the limited sensitivity of the $^{15}$N isotopologue observations. These results suggest that [DCN]/[DNC] may be governed not only by HCN/HNC isomeric chemistry but also by temperature-dependent deuterium fractionation pathways and the chemical evolution of dense gas.

title: Disentangling Disk and Broad-Line Region Continuum Emission in a Sample of Active Galactic Nuclei
background_knowledge:
活动星系核（AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞、吸积盘、热冕、宽线区（BLR）、窄线区及尘埃环等结构组成。紫外/光学连续谱通常被认为主要来自几何薄、光学厚的吸积盘热辐射；BLR 则是受盘辐射光致电离的高速云团，产生宽发射线，并通过复合、自由-自由及束缚-自由跃迁贡献弥漫连续谱（DC）。在 Balmer 跳变（约 3646 埃）和 Paschen 跳变（约 8204 埃）附近，DC 会留下区别于纯盘连续谱的谱形特征，因此可用于分解盘与 BLR 的连续谱贡献。
\n连续谱混响映射通过跨波段光变时延测量吸积盘不同半径的辐射区域，是检验标准薄盘模型的重要方法；但观测到的时延常大于薄盘预言，且 $u$ 波段出现超出，提示 BLR 的 DC 可能显著污染宽波段连续谱。该领域的研究范式通常包括多波段光变时延、光谱分解，以及基于辐射转移的云模型（如 Cloudy 与 LOC）生成模板，再与观测谱拟合。准确刻画 DC 对理解 AGN 能量收支、吸积盘结构、BLR 物理，以及利用连续谱定标黑洞质量等均具有基础意义。
contribution: 论文针对 31 个 AGN，使用哈勃空间望远镜（HST）的空间望远镜成像光谱仪（STIS）和甚大望远镜（VLT）的 X-shooter 光谱，每个源至少覆盖 Balmer 或 Paschen 跳变之一。作者用 Cloudy 在 LOC 模型下进行辐射转移计算，为每个源构建专属的 DC 光谱模板，并将其作为连续谱成分纳入光谱分解，从而量化 DC 贡献。**在 Balmer 跳变短波侧（约 3625 埃），DC 占盘连续谱与 DC 之和的平均比例约为 33%**；**Balmer 跳变对 DC 的约束强于 Paschen 跳变**。基于模拟光谱的检验进一步表明，**不合适的模板会以波长相关的方式给推断的 DC 比例引入系统性偏差**。因此，采用恰当的 DC 模板对于在光谱分解中揭示可观的 DC 贡献至关重要；未来的时间分辨光谱将支持更精细建模，并对盘与 BLR 给出更紧密的约束。
summary: Recent continuum reverberation-mapping measurements of active galactic nuclei (AGNs) indicate that the inter-band time lags are significantly larger than those predicted by the light travel times across the standard thin model. In addition, the observed $u$-band excess suggests the presence of diffuse continuum (DC) radiation originating in the broad-line region (BLR). Spectroscopically, the Balmer and Paschen jumps in DC emission are unique indicators to quantify the contributions of the BLR to the observed continuum. Here, we study the DC contributions of 31 AGNs, whose spectra are obtained with the Space Telescope Imaging Spectrograph (STIS) on the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) and with X-shooter on the Very Large Telescope (VLT). In each spectrum, at least one of the Balmer and Paschen jumps is covered. For each object, we performed radiative transfer calculations using Cloudy within the Locally Optimally-emitting Clouds (LOC) model to construct source-specific DC spectral templates. We quantified the DC contribution by incorporating these templates as continuum components in spectral decomposition. The average ratio of the DC to total (i.e., disk+DC) continua is ~33% just below the Balmer jump (~3625 Å). The Balmer jump provides a stronger constraint on the DC component than the Paschen jump. Simulations based on mock spectra further demonstrate that an unsuitable template can introduce systematic, wavelength-dependent biases to the inferred DC fraction. Our results underscore the importance of employing appropriate DC templates in the spectral decomposition to infer the substantial DC contribution. Upcoming time-resolved spectra will enable more detailed modelling and tighter constraints on the disk and BLR.

title: A High-Resolution Stellar Extinction Map of M31 from PHAT and PHAST Photometry
background_knowledge: 星际尘埃是星系星际介质的重要组成部分，会通过吸收和散射星光产生消光，并使天体颜色变红。观测上常用视觉消光 $A_V$ 与色余 $E(B-V)$ 描述消光强度，并用消光律描述消光随波长的变化。高分辨率消光图既是校正单个天体测光与光谱观测的基础，也可用于研究尘埃分布、星际介质结构、恒星形成和星系演化。对于河外星系，传统尘埃发射图受红外分辨率和温度—发射率假设影响；而利用可分辨恒星的多波段测光，可将观测颜色与星等和经不同消光红化的恒星模板比较，逐星推断消光。M31 距离较近、倾角适中，是检验这类方法并绘制大视场高分辨率尘埃图的理想目标。HST 的 PHAT 与 PHAST 巡天提供了覆盖 M31 盘面的多波段高分辨率测光，结合恒星演化模型模板和空间自适应分箱，可在天区覆盖、空间分辨率与信噪比之间取得平衡。
contribution: 论文利用 HST PHAT 与 PHAST 巡天的多波段测光，基于 PARSEC 恒星演化模型构建恒星模板库，并采用 M31 的平均消光律，以类似 SPar 的匹配方法对约 6500 万颗恒星逐一反演 $A_V$，再通过 HEALPix 自适应分辨率方案生成 M31 的高分辨率、大覆盖恒星示踪消光图。所得图覆盖 M31 恒星形成盘约三分之二，最高空间分辨率为 1.61 角秒，图中消光中位值为 $A_V = 1.24$ mag。**与已有基于恒星和尘埃发射的消光图相比，大尺度形态总体一致，但消光数值仍存在差异。** 新图进一步揭示了臂间纤维状结构、超新星驱动空洞和分支状结构等精细特征。**该图已通过 NADC 平台公开发布，预期将成为后续观测消光校正及 M31 相关科学研究的重要观测基础。**
summary: High-resolution extinction maps of resolved external galaxies, such as M31, are crucial not only for accurately correcting dust extinction and reddening toward individual sources within the galaxy, but also for characterizing the distribution and evolution of interstellar dust in external galactic environments. We aim to construct a high-resolution and large-coverage stellar-traced extinction map of M31, based on multi-band photometric data from the HST PHAT and PHAST surveys. Using a stellar template library built from the PARSEC stellar evolution models and adopting the average extinction law of M31, we apply a matching method analogous to the SPar algorithm to derive A_V values for approximately 65 million stars. The extinction map is then generated using a HEALPix adaptive-resolution scheme. The resulting map covers approximately two-thirds of the star-forming disk of M31, with a maximum spatial resolution of 1.61 arcsec. The median extinction across the map is A_V = 1.24 mag. Comparison with previously published stellar- and dust-emission-based extinction maps shows broadly similar large-scale morphology, while differences remain in the extinction values. The extinction map further reveals fine-scale features such as inter-arm filaments, supernova-driven cavities, and spur-like structures. The map has been publicly released through the NADC platform and is expected to serve as an important observational basis for extinction correction in subsequent astronomical observations and for related M31 scientific studies.

title: Generative Bayesian modelling of radio antenna beams An application to the MeerKAT radio telescope
background_knowledge: 射电干涉阵列通过多台天线同步观测，由可见度函数重建天空亮度分布。每台天线的方向响应即主波束会乘在真实天空信号上，并随频率、指向和极化变化；若波束模型不准，校准会吸收波束误差，导致通量标度、宽视场成像、谱线动态范围及前景去除出现系统偏差。传统方案包括解析模型（高斯、Airy 盘等）、电磁仿真和全息测量：前者简单但难描述真实旁瓣和频率结构，后两者精度高却面临存储、插值与计算成本。信息场理论把待反演函数视为随机场，结合贝叶斯先验与噪声模型进行非参数重建，适合从稀疏、含噪测量中生成可压缩且便于接入校准与成像流程的波束表示。
contribution: 本文提出一种生成式贝叶斯主波束模型，可同时刻画波束的空间结构与频率变化，并保持可用于校准和成像流程的计算可处理性。方法基于信息场理论，采用非参数贝叶斯框架并通过 NIFTy 库实现；模型把波束表示为一个基础图样经受频率相关的几何变换（缩放与平移）。作者将该方法应用于 MeerKAT 望远镜 L 波段、阵列平均的 Stokes I 全息测量数据。后验预测检查给出 $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}\sim 1$，表明模型与测量在统计上一致；模型在保持统计一致性的同时实现 **400:1 的数据压缩**，并在均方偏差上比高斯、Airy 盘、JimBeam、Eidos 及电磁仿真等现有方法**优出一个数量级以上**。对基础波束进行 Zernike 分解并结合几何变换，可在任意空间分辨率上高效重建波束。模型每天线占用约 **150 kB**，便于以可忽略成本、低内存地集成进校准与成像软件，并可良好扩展至大规模阵列与宽带宽观测，也易于适配其他射电望远镜。
summary: Accurate primary beam models are essential for high-fidelity calibration and imaging in radio astronomy. Traditional approaches either lack the ability to represent realistic antenna patterns (analytical models) or become computationally prohibitive to interpolate for wide-bandwidth observations (electromagnetic simulations, direct holographic measurements). We develop a generative beam model that represents both the spatial structure and the frequency variations in the primary beam while remaining tractable for integration into calibration and imaging pipelines, achieving superior accuracy compared to existing parametric models and reducing data storage compared to data-based models. We adopt a non-parametric Bayesian framework grounded in information field theory, implemented using the NIFTy library. The model represents the beam as a base pattern subject to frequency-dependent geometric transformations (scaling and shifting). Performance is validated through posterior predictive checks (chi^2/dof ~ 1) and compared against traditional models (Gaussian, Airy disc, JimBeam, Eidos, electromagnetic simulation). We apply the method to holographic data of the array-averaged MeerKAT Stokes I beam in the L band. The model achieves 400:1 data compression while preserving statistical consistency with holographic measurements, and outperforms existing approaches by more than an order of magnitude in mean squared deviation. Zernike decomposition of the base beam, combined with the geometric transformations, enables efficient beam reconstruction at arbitrary spatial resolution. The 150 kB per-antenna footprint enables memory-slim integration into calibration and imaging software at negligible cost, scales favourably to large arrays and wide bandwidths, and can be readily adapted to other radio telescopes.

title: PHOTO-CAT - Photometric Contamination Analyzer Tool: A High-Performance Framework for Photometric Contamination Assessment
background_knowledge: 高精度测光（如凌星法寻找系外行星、星震学与恒星变率研究）依赖对目标恒星总流量的准确测量。实际观测中，目标孔径或点扩散函数（PSF）覆盖范围内常混入邻近恒星的光，导致目标光变曲线的振幅被稀释、凌星深度被低估，并影响测光精度与后续物理参数推断。传统上，研究者借助天体测量星表、角距离、星等或流量以及望远镜孔径或 PSF 模型评估污染；在大规模巡天时代，需要可扩展、可跨任务复用且能处理千万至亿级源表的工具，以在观测前进行目标筛选和观测几何优化。相关研究范式包括基于星表的三维天球邻域搜索、流量比与孔径模型计算、按仪器波段转换流量，以及输出污染比、目标纯度等诊断量。
contribution: 论文提出并介绍 PHOTO-CAT，一个由星表驱动、与任务无关的测光污染评估工具。该工具基于用户提供天体测量星表构建天球的三维欧氏表示，使用内存优化的 KDTree 进行快速邻域搜索，并根据角距离、相对流量以及可配置孔径模型（top-hat 或圆形 Gaussian PSF）计算每个目标的污染指标；这些指标可选地通过经验测光关系或恒星光谱模型转换到任意仪器波段。其流式、CSR 风格存储格式与紧凑内部标识符使工具能够以很低的内存开销处理数千万至数亿个源的星表。输出包括每个目标的污染流量、污染比、目标纯度、邻星数量及其角距离，可用于观测前的目标筛选与视场选择。**作者在全天 Gaia 样本（$G \leq 12$，邻星低至 $G = 17$，超过三百万个目标）上展示了软件性能，给出全天污染统计与拥挤区域的空间刻画。** **将该工具应用于 Ariel Mission Candidate Sample，表明波长相关的污染估计可支持目标选择与观测几何优化。** **尽管为 Mauve 卫星开发，PHOTO-CAT 与任务无关，可推广至 TESS、PLATO、Ariel 及其他巡天。**
summary: High-precision photometric missions are sensitive to flux contamination from neighboring stars, which can bias light curves, dilute transit depths, and compromise photometric precision. We present PHOTO-CAT, a catalog-driven, mission-agnostic tool for quantifying stellar flux contamination in photometric observations. The tool builds a three-dimensional Euclidean representation of the sky from a user-provided astrometric catalog, indexes it with a memory-optimized KDTree for rapid neighbor searches, and computes per-target contamination metrics from angular separation, relative fluxes, and configurable aperture models (top-hat or circular Gaussian PSF), optionally converted into an arbitrary instrumental bandpass via empirical photometric relations or stellar spectral models. A streaming, CSR-style storage format with compact internal identifiers enables scalable processing of catalogs with tens to hundreds of millions of sources with minimal memory overhead. Outputs include per-target contaminating flux, contamination ratios, target purity, number of neighboring sources, and their angular separations, supporting target screening and field-selection decisions ahead of observations. We demonstrate the software performance on all-sky Gaia samples (G <= 12, with neighbors down to G = 17; over three million targets), providing global contamination statistics and spatial characterization of crowded regions, and apply it to the Ariel Mission Candidate Sample to show how wavelength-dependent contamination estimates support target selection and observing-geometry optimization. Although developed for the Mauve satellite, PHOTO-CAT is mission-agnostic and readily applicable to TESS, PLATO, Ariel, and other surveys.

title: Water-ice formation in Ophiuchus follows the local irradiation
background_knowledge: 分子云中的星际尘埃颗粒表面会吸附气体中的水等分子，形成冰幔；水冰通常在光学/近红外消光达到一定深度后才显著出现，因为云表面的紫外光子会光致解吸或破坏冰。传统上常把这一出现位置描述为每个分子云一个消光阈值。云表面被紫外场激发的多环芳烃（PAHs）在中红外发射，因此固定消光下的 12 $\mu$m 表面亮度可作为局部辐照强度的示踪。观测上，利用背景星在 3 $\mu$m 水冰吸收带处的颜色超额，可把测光数据转换为冰带峰值光学厚度，并据此扫描分子云内不同视线。
